articles.title: Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? Diagnosing and Aligning Action-Conditioned Generation for Policy Learning
articles.content: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as learned simulators for policy evaluation and improvement, yet their effectiveness rests on an unverified assumption: generated futures faithfully reflect arbitrary valid actions. Existing benchmarks are typically confined to expert demonstrations, leaving off-expert action following inadequately evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce WorldEcho, which probes action following over a broader action distribution using visual integrity and SE(3) trajectory alignment. Our diagnosis shows that current world models reasonably execute expert actions but struggle with diverse off-expert trajectories, either ignoring the commanded actions or producing visually invalid rollouts. We further propose WorldSync, which strengthens action following along three complementary axes: distributional coverage, representational grounding, and intervention-effect alignment. It broadens the training distribution over action consequences, grounds intermediate video representations in action-induced robot dynamics through an Action-Forcing Expert, and aligns predicted changes under action interventions with the corresponding changes in ground-truth futures. Experiments on RoboTwin benchmarks and real-robot tasks show that WorldSync improves WorldEcho metrics and serves as a more reliable simulator for iterative policy improvement, enabling policies to achieve higher success rates.

articles.title_zh: 机器人世界模型真的跟随动作吗? 诊断和调整符合行动条件的政策学习一代
articles.content_zh: 以行动为条件的世界模式越来越多地被用作政策评价和改进的学习模拟器,但其有效性取决于一个未经核实的假设:产生的未来忠实地反映了武断的有效行动。 现有基准通常限于专家示范,在评价不充分之后,将非专家行动排除在外。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了WorldEcho,它利用视觉完整性和SE(3)轨迹对准,在更广泛的动作分布之后探索行动. 我们的诊断表明,目前的世界模式合理执行专家行动,但与不同的非专家轨迹斗争,要么无视命令的行动,要么产生视效无效的推出。 我们进一步提议世界同步,它沿着三个互补轴线加强行动:分布覆盖范围、代表性基础和干预效果协调。 它扩大了培训的传播范围,超越行动后果,通过一名行动-强制执行专家,将中间视频显示在行动引起的机器人动态中,并将行动干预下的预测变化与地面-真实未来的相应变化相配合。 关于RoboTwin基准和真机器人任务的实验表明,WorldSync改进了WorldEcho的度量衡,并充当了更可靠的迭代政策改进模拟器,使政策能够实现更高的成功率.

articles.title: From Seeing to Acting: Smart Glasses as First-Person Intelligence Platforms
articles.content: Smart glasses are evolving from capture and display accessories into first-person intelligence platforms that connect human perception, persistent context, and digital or physical action. Their on-body viewpoint aligns with the wearer's vision, audition, motion, and hand-object interaction, but must operate under tight energy, thermal, privacy, and feedback constraints. Despite rapid progress in augmented reality, egocentric vision, multimodal models, human-computer interaction, and embodied intelligence, the literature remains fragmented across devices, tasks, and benchmarks. \textit{The key challenge is not whether a model can recognize, answer, remember, or act in isolation, but whether a complete system can sustain a reliable, temporally valid, correctable, and governable perception-state-interaction-action loop.} This survey is \textit{the \textbf{first} to systematically study smart glasses through such a unified framework}. We formalize first-person data flow and constrained task utility, characterize devices along eight verifiable hardware capability axes, organize the literature around seven interdependent foundational capabilities, and introduce an L0-L5 framework spanning capture, reactive perception, contextual assistance, persistent state, governed action, and embodied coupling. Across nine application scenes, we connect tasks with datasets, systems, products, stakeholders, failure consequences, and evidence gaps. We further present a nine-dimensional deployment framework, a claim-conditioned evaluation protocol, and an evidence ladder from controlled measurement to longitudinal field validation and audit. Together, these elements make smart glasses more comparable, deployable, and reproducibly evaluated, while outlining a roadmap toward trustworthy first-person intelligence.

articles.title_zh: 从看到演技:智能眼镜作为第一人称智能平台
articles.content_zh: 智能眼镜正在从捕捉和显示附件演化成第一人称智能平台,将人类的感知,持续上下文,以及数字或物理动作联系起来. 他们的身体视角与穿戴者的视觉,试镜,运动,和手物体的相互作用一致,但必须在紧凑的能量,热能,隐私和反馈限制下运行. 尽管在增强现实、以自我为中心的愿景、多式联运模式、人与计算机互动以及体现的智能方面迅速取得进展,但各种手段、任务和基准的文献仍然支离破碎。 \ textit{ 关键的挑战不是一个模型是否能够识别、回答、记住或单独行动,而是一个完整的系统是否能够维持一个可靠、时间上有效、可纠正和可治理的认知-状态-互动-行动循环。 } 本次调查是\ textit{ the\ textbf{ first} 通过这样一个统一的框架系统研究智能眼镜} 。 我们正式确定第一人称数据流和受限任务效用,按照八个可核查的硬件能力轴对设备进行定性,围绕七个相互依存的基础能力组织文献,并引入一个L0-L5框架,涵盖捕捉、反应感知、上下文援助、持续状态、管理行动以及结合。 在9个应用场景中,我们把任务与数据集、系统、产品、利益攸关方、故障后果和证据缺口联系起来。 我们进一步提出一个九维部署框架,一个具有索赔条件的评价协议,以及从控制计量到纵向实地验证和审计的证据阶梯。 这些元素共同使智能眼镜更具有可比性,可部署性,并可以再现评价,同时勾画出通往可信第一人称智能的路线图.

articles.title: LeFlow: Generative Latent Flow Planning for World Models
articles.content: Latent world models are inherently strong encoders that transform image pixel to latent embedding, yet existing world models still rely on online trajectory optimization for action planning: for every state-goal pair, an iterative optimizer is run from scratch to search for optimal action sequences, treating the world model as a black-box simulator. This approach pays the full iterative optimization cost anew at every replanning step and reuses no planning experience across queries. In this work, we ask whether planning itself can be amortized once a latent world model has been learned. We present LeFlow, which learns a reusable latent trajectory prior operating directly in the latent dynamics space from the world model. LeFlow recasts planning as conditional latent trajectory generation: a rectified-flow model imagines a future latent path between the current and goal embeddings, an inverse dynamics decoder turns latent transitions into action chunks, and the frozen world model verifies each candidate by autoregressive rollout. Across four major goal-conditioned pixel-control benchmarks, LeFlow replaces iterative action-space optimization with amortized latent planning and fixed-budget rollout selection, achieving consistent success-rate gains with an order-of-magnitude reduction in planning time. Our results argue that latent world models should support not only prediction but reusable planning priors. Our code is available at https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/LeFlow.

articles.title_zh: LeFlow:为世界模式进行基因底线流动规划
articles.content_zh: 后期世界模型是内在强大的编码器,可以将图像像素转化为潜伏的嵌入,然而现有的世界模型仍然依靠在线轨道优化来进行行动规划:对于每一个状态目标对,一个迭代优化器从头运行到寻找最佳动作序列,将世界模型作为黑箱模拟器. 这种方法在每一重新规划步骤中都支付全部迭代优化的费用,而且不重复所有查询的规划经验。 在这项工作中,我们问,一旦了解了潜在的世界模式,规划本身是否可以摊销。 我们介绍LeFlow,它从世界模型中吸取了在潜在动态空间直接运行之前可重复使用的潜在轨迹。 LeFlow将规划重新设定为有条件的潜伏轨迹生成:一个修正流模型设想了当前嵌入和目标嵌入之间的未来潜伏路径,反向动态解码器将潜伏的过渡转化为动作块,被冻结的世界模型通过自动递减推出来验证每个候选者. 在四大目标条件像素控制基准中,LeFlow以摊余的潜在规划和固定预算推出选择取代迭代行动空间优化,通过减少规划时间的幅度,实现一致的成功率收益。 我们的结果认为,潜在的世界模型不仅应支持预测,而且应支持可重复使用的规划前科。 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/hsiangwei0903/LeFlow.

articles.title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
articles.content: We present LAION-BVD, a large-scale open video dataset for multimodal learning, which contains 1.3B platform-specific video URLs collected from CommonCrawl. From these, we download 80M videos with a total duration of 10 million hours. The dataset is designed for multimodal pre-training across the video, audio, and image modalities. Using content-aware scene detection, we extract clips for which we synthetically generate video and audio captions. Models trained on these data achieve competitive performance on standard video-text and audio-text benchmarks, with consistent improvements as training or model scale increases. Additionally, we explore video frames as an alternative source of image-text data by extracting scene-changing frames. These frames exhibit a visual distribution distinct from standard web image corpora, and models trained on this dataset achieve strong image-text retrieval performance. We release LAION-BVD to the research community. It significantly expands open access to multimodal videos at an unprecedented scale.

articles.title_zh: LAION-BVD:用于多式联运的10亿千兆小时开放视频数据集 培训前
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍LAION-BVD,这是一个用于多模式学习的大规模开放式视频数据集,包含从CommonCrawl收集的1.3B平台专用视频URL. 从这些视频中,我们下载了总时长为1000万小时的80M视频. 该数据集是为跨视频、音频和图像模式的多式联运预训设计的。 我们利用了解内容的场景探测,提取出我们合成视频和音频字幕的剪辑。 在这些数据方面接受过培训的模型在标准视频文本和音频文本基准方面实现了竞争业绩,随着培训或模型规模的扩大,这些模型得到了一致的改进。 此外,我们通过提取场景变化帧来探索视频帧作为图像文本数据的替代来源. 这些帧呈现出不同于标准网络图像corpora的视觉分布,在此数据集上接受过训练的模型实现了强大的图像文本检索性能. 我们把LAION -BVD放给研究界 它以前所未有的规模大大扩展了对多式联运视频的开放性。

articles.title: EMFE: A lightweight, explainable machine learning framework for malaria cell classification
articles.content: Automated malaria diagnosis from stained blood-smear microscopy is dominated by deep convolutional neural networks that are accurate but computationally expensive, poorly interpretable, and rarely validated with patient-level rigor. We present EMFE (Efficient Mathematical Feature Extraction), a five-feature framework for classifying single red-blood-cell images as parasitized or uninfected using Gray World color normalization, adaptive green-channel thresholding, morphological spot detection, and classical machine learning. Using the NIH LHNCBC malaria dataset (27,558 images from 200 patients), we evaluate Random Forest, Histogram Gradient Boosting, and Support Vector Machine classifiers under patient-grouped nested cross-validation (K_outer=20, K_inner=3), ensuring that cells from each patient remain within a single fold. The optimized Random Forest achieves 94.6% pooled out-of-fold accuracy (95% CI [93.6, 95.7]), corroborated by an untouched 40-patient holdout test (94.3%) and a patient-level permutation test (p<0.001, 1,000 permutations). Ablation experiments quantify the contribution of individual features and pipeline stages. Hardware-matched comparisons with retrained DenseNet121, ResNet50, and MobileNetV2 models assess the accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Synthetic perturbations characterize three failure modes, while explainability analysis identifies spot saturation as the dominant discriminative feature. Patient-level aggregation further quantifies sensitivity-specificity trade-offs and false-positive accumulation. These results demonstrate a statistically rigorous, interpretable, and computationally lightweight alternative to deep learning, while explicitly quantifying its limitations.

articles.title_zh: EMFE:疟疾细胞分类的轻量级、可解释的机器学习框架
articles.content_zh: 污血显微镜中的疟疾自动诊断以深层神经网络为主,这些神经网络精准但计算成本昂贵,解释不严,很少用病人水平的硬度验证. 我们提出EMFE(Efficient Mathematical Feature Departmenton),是利用灰尘世界色彩正常化,适应性绿色通道阈值,形态斑点检测,以及古典机器学习,将单一红细胞图像归类为寄生体或未感染的五地框架. 利用NIH LHNCBC疟疾数据集(来自200名患者的27,558张图像),我们评价了随机林,直方图梯度助推,以及支持矢量机在患者组巢交叉验证下进行分类(K_outer=20,K_inner=3),确保每个患者的细胞保持单叠. 优化的随机森林实现了94.6%的集合出倍精度(95% CI [93.6, 95.7]),并得到了未经改变的40位患者坚持试验(94.3%)和患者水平的坚持试验(p<0.001,1000 permutions)的证实. 疏导实验量化单个特征和管道阶段的贡献. 与再培训的DenseNet121、ResNet50和MobileNetV2模型的硬件匹配比较评估了准确效率的权衡。 合成扰动特征为三种故障模式,而可解释性分析则将斑点饱和确定为主要的区别特征. 患者层面的汇总进一步量化了敏感性-特异性权衡和假阳性积累. 这些结果表明,在统计学上严格、可解释和计算上轻量级替代深层学习,同时明确量化其局限性。

articles.title: MoE-based Feature Adapter for Prompt-free Binary Coronary Artery Segmentation in X-ray Angiography
articles.content: Accurate segmentation of coronary arteries in X-ray angiography videos is essential for quantitative coronary analysis and image-guided interventions. However, accurate segmentation remains challenging because coronary vessels are thin and exhibit low contrast, while the presence of catheters, guidewires, and complex anatomical background structures can further interfere with vessel delineation. Existing U-Net- and Transformer-based models provide strong baselines, but their shared feature-adaptation pathways may be insufficient for heterogeneous angiographic appearances. In this paper, we propose a prompt-free mixture-of-experts (MoE) feature adapter for binary coronary artery segmentation. Built upon parameter-efficient Vision Transformer adapters, the proposed method uses multiple lightweight experts with input-dependent top-$k$ routing to adaptively refine vessel-related features while limiting active computational cost. Experiments on MOSXAV and external evaluation on XACV show that the proposed method outperforms representative baselines and improves cross-dataset generalisation. These results suggest that MoE-based adapter learning is effective for robust coronary artery segmentation in X-ray angiography videos.

articles.title_zh: 基于 MoE 的特性适配器,用于X射线血管造影学中快速无二元冠状动脉切片
articles.content_zh: 在X射线血管造影视频中精确分解冠状动脉对于定量冠状分析和图像引导干预至关重要. 然而,准确的分解仍然具有挑战性,因为冠状舰体较薄且呈低对比度,而导管,导线和复杂的解剖背景结构的存在会进一步干扰舰只的划定. 现有的基于U-Net和变形器的模型提供了强有力的基线,但其共同的特征适应路径可能不足以用于不同的血管外观。 在本文中,我们提出一个快速无杂交的专家特性适配器,用于二元冠动脉分化. 拟议方法以参数效率高的Visual Transformer适配器为基础,采用多位轻量级专家,采用依赖投入的顶-美元路由,以适应性地完善与船舶有关的特性,同时限制主动计算成本。 关于MOSXAV的实验和关于XACV的外部评价表明,拟议方法的绩效超过了有代表性的基线,改进了跨数据集的概括性。 这些结果表明,基于MOE的适配器学习对于X射线血管造影视频中强壮的冠状动脉分裂是有效的.

articles.title: Image Difference Quantification Using Autoencoder-Based Latent Representations
articles.content: Traditional image similarity metrics such as Mean Squared Error (MSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and the Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) rely on pixel-level comparisons and often fail to capture perceptually meaningful differences between images. In contrast, latent representations learned by deep neural networks encode high-level semantic information that is more closely aligned with human visual perception. This paper proposes a convolutional autoencoder-based framework for quantifying image differences using cosine similarity in latent space. The learned compact embeddings enable robust differentiation between visually distinct images under variations in illumination, pose, and background. Extensive evaluation on dog-cat images and additional cross-domain datasets demonstrates clear class-wise clustering and strong inter-class separability in the latent space, with 98.4% of dog-cat image pairs exhibiting similarity scores below 0.5. Further validation using the TID2013 dataset shows that latent-space distance correlates positively with human Mean Opinion Scores (MOS), demonstrating sensitivity to perceptually relevant image distortions. The proposed approach provides a computationally efficient and semantically grounded alternative to conventional pixel-based similarity metrics, with potential applications in content-based retrieval, perceptual quality assessment, and semantic similarity analysis.

articles.content_zh: 传统的图像相似度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度 相比之下,深层神经网络所学到的潜在表达方式编码了与人类视觉感知更紧密结合的高级语义信息. 本文提出一个以自动编码器为基础的演化框架,利用潜在空间的余弦相似性量化图像差异。 学习到的紧凑嵌入使得在照明、姿势和背景的变化下,能对视觉上不同的图像进行有力的区分。 对狗猫图像和更多跨域数据集的广泛评价表明,在潜伏空间中,有明显的类群和强烈的类间分离性,98.4%的狗猫图像对显示的相似性分数低于0.5. 使用TID2013数据集的进一步验证表明,潜在-空间距离与人类平均值分数(MOS)有正相关关系,显示出对感知相关图像扭曲的敏感性. 提议的办法提供了一种计算高效和基于模拟的替代常规像素的类似度量标准,在基于内容的检索、感知质量评估和语义相似度分析方面有潜在的应用。

articles.title: Ensemble of Convolutional Neural Networks for StrokePrediction: Towards Improved Diagnostic Accuracy
articles.content: Brain stroke, known for its high mortality and incidence rates, poses significant health risks and requires rapid intervention for survival. Early diagnosis and preventive measures can greatly reduce life loss and disabilities. Recent advancements in deep learning have led to novel computer-aided diagnostic techniques for early stroke detection. This study proposes an intelligent system that predicts potential strokes using eleven features, evaluated through seven supervised machine learning algorithms. The process includes a literature review, dataset visualization, data preprocessing, and model evaluation. Ensemble methods like Random Forest, Stacking Classifier, and Bagging Classifier achieved high accuracies of 99.52%, while Decision Tree reached 98.24%. Other models, including KNN and TabNet, demonstrated reliable performance, achieving accuracies of 96.73% and 96.49%, respectively. The custom feedforward model achieved 94.91%, while SVC and logistic regression had lower accuracies at 88.06% and 77.03%. The results highlight the effectiveness of ensemble methods in stroke classification.

articles.title_zh: 弦乐神经网络集成: 提高诊断准确性
articles.content_zh: 脑中风以高死亡率和发病率著称,对健康构成重大风险,需要迅速干预才能生存。 早期诊断和预防措施可以大大减少生命损失和残疾。 最近深入学习的进步导致了新型的计算机辅助诊断技术,用于早期中风检测. 本研究提出一个智能系统,利用11个特征预测潜在的中风,通过7个受监督的机器学习算法进行评估. 这一过程包括文献审查,数据集可视化,数据预处理,模型评价. articles.title: Score-Based Ideal Observer Approximation via Denoising Score Matching for Signal-Known-Exactly Detection Tasks
articles.content: The Bayesian Ideal Observer (IO) establishes the theoretical upper bound on task performance for binary detection tasks. However, analytical computation of the IO test statistic is generally intractable. Numerical approaches based on Markov-chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods, including their recent deep generative model-based extensions, typically require extensive posterior sampling for each test image. Supervised learning has also been investigated to approximate the IO performance. However, such methods are typically trained for a specific detection task and signal and may require retraining when the task or signal changes. The score function, defined as the gradient of the log probability density, encodes the local geometry of the data distribution and is a fundamental quantity in modern score-based generative modeling. This work reformulates the IO test statistic in terms of the score function and introduces a score-based ideal observer (SIO). The proposed SIO uses a denoising convolutional neural network trained exclusively on signal-absent images to estimate the signal-absent score function. Once trained, the resulting score model can be used to approximate the IO test statistic for detection tasks involving arbitrary additive signals, without per-image posterior sampling or signal-specific retraining. Numerical studies consider a signal-known-exactly (SKE) detection task with a stochastic lumpy-background model. The results demonstrate that the proposed SIO can closely approximate the IO performance.

articles.title_zh: 通过 Denoising 分数匹配信号- 了解- 精确检测任务进行计分目标观察
articles.content_zh: 贝叶斯理想观察者(IO)为二进制检测任务确定了对任务性能的理论上限. 然而,对IO测试统计的分析计算一般难以进行。 基于Markov-chain Monte Carlo(MCMC)方法的数值方法,包括其最近的基于基因的深层模型扩展,通常需要对每个测试图像进行广泛的后取样。 对监督学习也进行了调查,以大致了解IO的表现。 然而,这类方法通常为特定检测任务和信号而培训,在任务或信号发生变化时可能需要再培训。 记分函数,定义为日志概率密度的梯度,编码了数据分布的局部几何,是现代记分基因模型中的一个基本数量. 这项工作从分数函数的角度重新制定了IO测试统计,并引入了基于分数的理想观察者(SIO). 拟议的SIO使用一个专门接受信号缺失图像培训的去诺氏神经网络来估计信号缺失得分功能. 一旦经过培训,所产生的分数模型可以用来对涉及任意添加剂信号的检测任务的IO测试统计进行近似化,而无需逐象后取样或针对信号的再培训. 数字学研究考虑一种信号已知的精确(SKE)检测任务,并采用有条理的整块背景模型. 结果显示,拟议的SIO可以接近IO的性能.

articles.title: MoTE: Mixture of Task Experts for Multi-Task Video Understanding
articles.content: Procedural video-language models must solve heterogeneous tasks from the same visual evidence, including action recognition, forecasting, and procedure prediction. Dense transformer decoders share the same feed-forward networks across tasks, which can entangle task behavior and make controlled capability expansion difficult. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) decoders provide conditional computation, but token-level learned routing is not naturally aligned with task-level procedural objectives. We propose MoTE (Mixture of Task Experts), a decoder architecture that converts large language model feed-forward networks into task-specific experts while keeping the multimodal backbone shared. Each example follows one sample-level task route, so active task-expert computation remains independent of the number of stored task experts. We instantiate this design as VideoLLM-MoTE and evaluate it on five COIN benchmarks using explicit task routes. The five-expert model activates ~2B LLM parameters per sample and achieves higher average top-1 accuracy than recent VideoLLM baselines. Under the same expert topology, it improves over dense all-expert activation and learned sparse-routing controls. These results show that task-structured routing provides an interpretable and compute-efficient decoder alternative for multi-task video-language learning.

articles.title_zh: MoTE:多任务视频理解任务专家组合
articles.content_zh: 程序视频语言模型必须解决来自同一视觉证据的不同任务,包括动作识别、预测和程序预测。 Dense变压器解码器在任务之间共享相同的feed-forward网络,这可以缠绕任务行为,使受控能力扩展变得困难. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)解码器提供有条件的计算,但令牌级学习的路由并非自然与任务级程序目标一致. 我们提议采用MoTE(任务专家混合)这一解码器架构,将大型语言模型的向导网络转换成任务专家,同时保持多式联运主干网的共享。 每个例子都遵循一个样本级的任务路径,因此主动的任务专家计算仍然独立于存储的任务专家的数量. 并使用明确的任务路线, 五专家模型激活每个样本的~2B LLM参数,并实现高于近期VideoLLM基线的平均最高-1精度. 在同样的专家地形学下,它改进了密集的全专家激活和学习的稀疏路径控制. 这些结果显示,任务结构的路由为多任务视频语言学习提供了一个可解释和计算高效的解码器替代品.

articles.title: IDeaL: Data-Free Multi-Teacher Distillation via Improved Dead Leaves
articles.content: Multi-teacher distillation has emerged as a way to combine complementary teacher models into a single student model that exhibits the strengths of all its teachers. The student is trained to mimic the output of the teachers on a set of images, typically the union of the individual teacher's training sets, assuming this data is available. In this paper, we question that assumption and explore alternative options. We first study how far one can go when distilling from teachers fed with different types of noise. Then, we show that information contained in the teachers can be leveraged to tailor the noise for multi-teacher distillation: we propose a method that, thanks to decorrelation losses at both patch and image levels, generates teacher-specific, improved samples optimized for data-free distillation. Experiments show that our most effective samples, IDeaL, lead to strong students that successfully capture complementary information from the teachers, yielding surprisingly competitive results that substantially narrow the gap with students distilled from real images. Moreover, given a limited budget of 1K images for distillation, students distilled using our IDeaL samples match or surpass the performance of those distilled using a 1K-image subset of ImageNet.

articles.title_zh: IDeaL: 通过改进的死叶进行无数据多教师蒸馏
articles.content_zh: 多教师蒸馏法已成为将互补的教师模式整合为单一学生模式的一种方式,展现了所有教师的长处。 学生接受培训,以模仿教师在一套图象上的产出,即假定有这些数据,一般是个别教师培训的组合。 在本文件中,我们质疑这一假设,并探讨其他选择。 我们首先研究当教师从不同种类的噪音中蒸馏出来时能走多远。 然后,我们显示,可以利用教师中包含的信息来裁剪多教师蒸馏的噪音:我们提出了一个方法,由于在补丁和图像两个层面的装饰关系损失,可以生成针对教师的、经过改进的样本,用于无数据蒸馏。 实验显示,我们最有效的样本IDeaL 导致强大的学生成功从教师那里获取补充信息,产生惊人的竞争结果,大大缩小了与从真实图像中提取的学生的差距。 此外,由于用于蒸馏的1K图像预算有限,学生使用我们的IDeaL样本进行蒸馏,使用ImageNet的1K-图像子集进行蒸馏或超过蒸馏的性能。

articles.title: Weakly Supervised Seafloor Segmentation for Seagrass Habitat Mapping in Side-Scan Sonar Imagery
articles.content: Seagrass meadows are crucial blue-carbon habitats, and mapping their extent is a prerequisite for coastal management and carbon inventory. Optical satellite sensors cover large areas but cannot reach deep or turbid water, whereas side-scan sonar (SSS) images the seabed at high resolution and at any depth. Interpreting SSS, however, still relies on dense manual annotation, which is slow and costly. We address this by adapting a weakly supervised semantic segmentation framework to SSS benthic habitat mapping, so that pixel-level maps are learned from image-level labels alone. The framework couples a ViT-based encoder-decoder with a classification branch, extracts class activation maps, and refines them into pseudo-labels with a dense conditional random field that we tune for the noise and weak boundaries of acoustic imagery. It follows an iterative self-training scheme, together with a sampling strategy to cope with the strong class imbalance of the data. We also study the effect of different loss functions on segmentation quality, finding Lovász-Softmax loss the most effective. On a held-out transect, the refined pseudo-labels reached an mIoU of 89.3\% against the ground truth, and the segmentation branch, trained without any pixel-level labels, reached 87.6\%. Self-supervised pretraining on unlabelled SSS added a further 3\% in mean intersection-over-union. Field trials further demonstrate the generalizability of the trained model. These results show that accurate and label-efficient benthic habitat mapping from side-scan sonar is feasible at the scale needed for coast-wide seagrass monitoring.

articles.title_zh: 在Scan声纳图像学中,海草生境测绘的海床分层
articles.content_zh: 海草草地是关键的蓝碳栖息地,测绘其范围是沿海管理和碳清查的先决条件. 光学卫星传感器覆盖大片区域,但无法到达深水或扰动水面,而侧扫描声纳则在高分辨率和任何深度上描绘海底。 然而,解释SS时仍依赖密集的人工注释,这种注释很慢,成本很高。 我们通过将一个受弱监督的语义分解框架适用于SS海底栖息地测绘来解决这个问题,从而仅从图像级标签中就能学到像素级地图。 框架将一个基于ViT的编码器-解码器配上一个分类分支,提取类激活图,并将其精炼成带有密集的有条件随机场的伪标签,我们为声像的噪声和弱边界调谐. 它遵循一种迭代自训练计划,以及处理数据严重阶级不平衡的抽样战略。 我们还研究不同损失功能对分区质量的影响,认为Lovász-Softmax损失最为有效。 在一个被搁置的截面上,精制的假标签达到了89.3\%的mIoU,与地面真理相对应,在没有任何像素级标签的情况下训练的分区分支达到了87.6\%. 对无标签的SS进行自我监督的预训在平均交叉结合中又增加了3++. 实地试验进一步表明训练有素的模式是普遍适用的。 这些结果表明,通过侧扫描声纳绘制准确和具有标签效率的海底生境图谱,在全海岸海草监测所需的规模上是可行的。

articles.title: TorchMorph: CUDA-accelerated Morphological Transforms
articles.content: Morphological transforms are long-standing tools for shape and mask processing, but the de facto reference implementation in the Python ecosystem, i.e. scipy.ndimage, is CPU-only, single-array, and therefore unusable inside a GPU training loop without an expensive device-to-host round trip. GPU vision libraries built on PyTorch cover a narrow subset of these operators, typically restricted to two spatial dimensions and flat structuring elements. We present TorchMorph, a lightweight PyTorch extension that closes this gap. TorchMorph exposes 22 public operators covering binary morphology, greyscale morphology, exact and approximate distance transforms, and entropy-regularised optimal transport, all implemented as fused CUDA kernels that operate directly on (B, C, Spatial...) CUDA tensors with up to eight spatial dimensions. The API deliberately mirrors scipy.ndimage argument-for-argument, including border modes, structuring-element origins and pre-allocated outputs, so that existing pipelines port with a change of import. We describe the layered architecture and the kernel designs behind each operator family. Against single-threaded CPU references, batched execution reaches up to 1.1e3 times the throughput of scipy.ndimage on greyscale morphology and up to 350x on exact Euclidean distance transforms, while the Sinkhorn solver runs up to 42x faster than POT. Binary and chamfer operators reproduce their SciPy counterparts exactly, and every float-valued operator agrees with the CPU reference to within 1.8e-6 absolute error. TorchMorph is released under the MIT licence at https://intcomp.github.io/tm.

articles.title_zh: 火炬摩尔:CUDA加速的摩尔变形
articles.content_zh: 形态变换是形状和面具处理的长期工具,但Python生态系统中事实上的参考执行,即scipy.ndimage,是CPU唯一的,单阵列的,因此在GPU训练环内无法使用,没有昂贵的设备对主机往返. 基于PyTorch的GPU视觉库覆盖了这些操作器的一个狭义子集,一般限于两个空间维度和平面结构元素. 我们提出火炬摩尔, 一个轻量级的PyTorch扩展, 关闭这个缺口。 火炬Morph暴露了22个公共运营商,涵盖二进制形态,灰度形态,精确和近似距离变换,以及肽类规范化的最佳迁移,都作为直接在(B,C,Space...)上运行的引信式CUDA内核执行. 具有最多8个空间维度的CUDA 百分位器. API刻意反射 scipy.ndimage 参数,包括边框模式,结构-元素起源和预分配输出,这样现有的管道端口会随着进口的改变而改变. 我们描述每个操作家家族背后的分层架构和内核设计. 针对单条的CPU引用,批量执行达到Scipy吞吐量的1.1e3倍. 灰度形态上的ndimage和精确的欧几利得距离上的最多350x变换,而辛克霍恩解析器运行速度则比POT快达42x. 二进制和chamfer操作器精确复制其SciPy对应的,每个浮标操作器都同意CPU在1.8e-6绝对误差范围内的引用. 火炬Morph根据麻省理工学院的许可发布于https://intcomp.github.io/tm.

articles.title: Interpretable Fundus Image Classification via Ring-Based Retinal Vasculature Features
articles.content: Retinal fundus photography is widely used for screening and monitoring ocular diseases, but many modern classification pipelines rely on deep latent representations and provide limited interpretability. This study develops an interpretable fundus image classification framework based on a ring-structured representation of the retinal vasculature centered on the optic disc. The method quantifies vessel geometry, color appearance, oxygenation-related vascular appearance, and vessel--background entropy within concentric retinal regions. These physiologically motivated descriptors are derived from vessel masks, image intensities, and optical-density measurements and aggregated across rings to capture spatial variation in vascular properties. Using only quantitative vascular descriptors, the proposed method achieved strong classification performance across three public fundus datasets. On HRF, it achieved 91.1\% accuracy using automatically generated vessel masks, matching RETFound, a vision transformer pretrained on large-scale retinal fundus image data, under the same evaluation setting. Additional analyses suggest that pretrained image models are sensitive to acquisition-related spatial cues, including fundus scale and retinal position within the field of view, as well as broader non-vessel image characteristics. This framework may support interpretable disease classification, quantitative retinal phenotyping, and retinal biomarker discovery without requiring large task-specific training datasets.

articles.title_zh: 通过环状视网膜瓦斯特征解释Fundus图像分类
articles.content_zh: 视网膜基金摄影被广泛用于筛查和监测视障疾病,但许多现代分类管道依赖于深潜的表示,提供有限的可解释性. 本研究基于以视盘为中心视网膜的环状结构表示,开发了可解释的Fundus影像分类框架. 该方法将容器几何,颜色外观,与氧有关的血管外观,以及同心视网膜区域内的容器-后地 en化. 这些生理动机的描述符来源于容器口罩、图像强度和光学密度测量以及跨环集合,以捕捉血管特性的空间变化。 该拟议方法仅使用定量血管描述符,在三个公共基金数据集中实现了强有力的分类性能。 在HRF上,它利用自动生成的容器口罩实现了91.1+++的精度,匹配了RETFoud,这是一台在大型视网膜基金图像数据上预先训练的视觉变压器,处于同样的评价环境之下. 其他分析表明,预先训练的图像模型对与获取有关的空间提示敏感,包括视野内的Fundus比例和视网膜位置,以及更广泛的非视网膜图像特征。 这一框架可以支持可解释的疾病分类、定量视网膜光圈和视网膜生物标志物的发现,而不需要大型的任务特定培训数据集。

articles.title: Deep Learning Super Resolution for Satellite Cloud Mask Downscaling
articles.content: A vast amount of optical satellite data is being transmitted to Earth-based servers every day, and more than half of this data is affected by haze or clouds. Additionally, this data suffers from the fundamental trade-off between spatial and temporal resolution, which remains largely unresolved, making the acquisition of continuous high-resolution satellite observations of clouds an ongoing challenge. This work addresses this challenge by proposing two Deep Learning super-resolution methods for the accurate downscaling of SEVIRI cloud mask products, as well as a novel cross-sensor cloud mask dataset called SEVMOD-CM, created by spatially and temporally matching MODIS and SEVIRI satellite observations. The two proposed models are a CNN-based (SpatialCNN) and a GAN-based (SpatialGAN) Neural Network. Trained on the SEVIRI spectral and cloud mask products, the proposed methods predict the corresponding MODIS Cloud masks, achieving a 4x spatial enhancement across sensor domains. Both approaches are evaluated experimentally, and compared against the standard bicubic interpolation upsampling technique. The experimental results demonstrate the value of the proposed models and dataset for the remote sensing community, highlighting the benefits of applying super-resolution techniques to geostationary-derived cloud mask products for applications such as atmospheric monitoring, weather forecasting, disaster risk reduction, solar energy forecasting, and climate research.

articles.title_zh: 卫星云罩降尺度的深层学习超解
articles.content_zh: 每天都有大量的光学卫星数据传输到地球服务器,超过一半的这些数据受到雾霾或云的影响. 此外,这一数据还受到空间分辨率和时间分辨率之间的根本权衡的影响,这种权衡在很大程度上仍未解决,因此不断获得对云的高分辨率卫星观测是一项持续的挑战。 这项工作解决了这一挑战,提出了两个用于精确降低SEVIRI云罩产品的深度学习超分辨率方法,以及一个新的跨传感器云罩数据集,名为SEVMOD-CM,由空间和时间匹配MODIS和SEVIRI卫星观测所创建. 拟议的两种模式是基于CNN的(SpatialCNN)和基于GAN的(SpatialGAN)神经网络. 在SIVIRI光谱和云罩产品上接受培训,拟议方法预测相应的MODIS云罩,实现跨越传感器域的4x空间增强. 这两种方法都经过实验性评价,并与标准的双立插图上取样技术进行比较。 实验结果显示了拟议的模型和数据集对遥感界的价值,突出了将超分辨率技术应用于地球静止派生云罩产品用于大气监测、天气预报、减少灾害风险、太阳能预报和气候研究等应用的好处。

articles.title: Game2World Engine: Unlocking In-the-Wild Gameplay Videos for World Model Training
articles.content: Video games provide a scalable source of training data for video world models, offering diverse environments, complex interactions, and abundant in-the-wild gameplay videos. However, raw gameplay footage entangles the game world with screen-space interfaces, introducing game-specific biases and irrelevant dynamics that hinder world-model training. To address this problem, we introduce GameUI-Taxonomy and G2WEngine, a full-stack framework that formalizes gameplay UI grounding and removal. G2WEngine automatically extracts reusable UI assets from real gameplay videos and synthesizes temporally coherent UI overlays on clean footage. Using this engine, we construct Game2World, comprising 96K synthetic paired videos with precise reconstruction targets and 1,079 in-the-wild clips from 303 games for realistic evaluation. Its asset library contains 5,132 verified UI elements across 21 taxonomy categories, collected from 1,010 representative gameplay frames. Based on Game2World, we propose GameCleaner, a mask-free gameplay UI removal model that combines multimodal semantic understanding with video editing capabilities. Unlike mask-based methods, GameCleaner directly identifies and removes diverse HUD elements while preserving the underlying scene content and temporal dynamics. In a controlled pilot, world models trained on UI-free gameplay improve overall VideoReward by 6.83% over those trained on UI-overlaid data. On UI-removal evaluation, GameCleaner achieves an average AAR of 95.36 on synthetic videos, outperforming the strongest temporal mask baseline by 57.3%, and obtains the best in-the-wild AAR of 80.05 with 99.8 background preservation. These results demonstrate the scalable potential of transforming Internet gameplay videos into high-quality world-model training data. Code, dataset, and model will be available at https://github.com/Dongping-Chen/Game2World.

articles.title_zh: Game2World Engine:为世界模式培训解锁游戏游戏视频
articles.content_zh: 电子游戏为视频世界模式提供了可扩展的培训数据来源,提供了多样的环境,复杂的互动,以及丰富多彩的游戏游戏游戏视频. 然而,原始的游戏剧情片段用屏幕-空间界面缠绕游戏世界,引入了特定游戏的偏差和阻碍世界模式训练的无关动态. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了GameUI-Taxonomy和G2WENGine,一个将游戏玩家UI定位和移除正式化的全层框架. G2WENGine从真实的游戏游戏视频中自动提取可重复使用的UI资产,并在干净的镜头上合成暂时一致的UI重叠. 使用此引擎,我们构建了Game2World,包含96K合成配对视频,并设定了精确的重建目标,以及303游戏中1,079个零散的剪辑,以进行现实的评价. 其资产库包含5,132个经过核实的UI元素,分属21个分类类别,收集自1,010个有代表性的游戏玩框. 基于Game2World,我们提出GameCleaner,一种无面具游戏游戏游戏UI移除模式,将多式联运语义理解与视频编辑能力相结合. 与基于面具的方法不同,GameCleaner直接识别并移除了多种HUD元素,同时保留了基础场景内容和时间动态. 在受控飞行员中,接受过UI免费游戏游戏培训的世界模型将整体Video Reward比接受UI覆盖数据培训的模型提高6.83%. 在UI迁移评价中,GameCleaner在合成视频上的平均AAR为95.36,表现优于最强时间面具基线57.3%,并获得80.05最佳的Win-wild AAR,同时保留99.8个背景. 这些结果表明,将互联网游戏播放视频转化为高质量的世界示范培训数据具有可扩展的潜力。 将在https://github.com/Dongping-Chen/Game2World上提供代码、数据集和模型。

articles.title: TurboT2VA: Fast Large-Scale Text-to-Video-Audio Generation via Score-Regularized Consistency Distillation
articles.content: Joint text-to-video-audio generation produces synchronized visual and acoustic content, but the long sampling trajectories and heterogeneous multimodal computation of large models make inference prohibitively expensive. We present TurboT2VA, a distillation and inference framework for accelerating a 19B-parameter joint video-audio model. Large-scale T2VA distillation is challenged by modality-imbalanced optimization, the difficulty of continuous-time consistency training at scale, and the quality--diversity trade-off. TurboT2VA addresses these issues with per-modality normalization and a progressive curriculum comprising discrete consistency warm-up, continuous consistency refinement, and joint consistency--distribution matching. The curriculum first establishes a stable, diverse generation trajectory and only then introduces distribution-level refinement. On LTX-2, four-step distillation reduces generator latency from 50.52s to 2.51s at the standard evaluation resolution of 512$\times$768, achieving a 20.1$\times$ speedup while maintaining strong visual quality, audio fidelity, diversity, and video-audio synchronization. We further develop an architecture-aware inference stack that combines guarded W8A8 and fused operators, padded-text compaction, and modality-aware sparse attention while preserving dense cross-modal and text-conditioning paths. Under the high-resolution deployment setting at 1024$\times$1792, the complete stack reduces generator latency from 318.74s to 5.83s on one NVIDIA H20, achieving a 54.67$\times$ generator-only speedup. Inference code and generation demos are available at https://github.com/thu-ml/TurboDiffusion/tree/main/turbot2va.

articles.title_zh: TurboT2VA:快速大尺度文本到视频-通过分数调节的音频生成
articles.content_zh: 联合文本到视频-音频生成产生同步的视觉和声学内容,但大型模型的长取样轨迹和多种多样的多式联运计算使得推论过于昂贵。 我们提出TurboT2VA,这是加速19B参数联合视频-音频模型的蒸馏和推论框架。 大型 T2 VA蒸馏受到模式-平衡优化、大规模持续时间一致性培训的困难以及质量-多样性的权衡的挑战。 TurboT2VA通过通式正常化和渐进式课程解决了这些问题,包括离散一致性暖和、持续一致性的完善以及一致性-分配的联合匹配。 课程首先确定了稳定多样的一代轨迹,然后才引入分布级的完善. 在LTX-2上,四步蒸馏在512美元\times 768的标准评价分辨率下将发电机的延迟度从50.52s降低到2.51s,实现20.1美元\times的加速,同时保持强视质量,音频忠实,多样性,视频-音频同步. 我们进一步开发一个建筑意识推论堆,将防守的W8A8和引信操作员、加法文本紧凑、以及模式意识稀少的注意力结合起来,同时保留密集的跨模式和文本调节路径。 根据高清部署设置为1024美元\时间1792美元,整堆将一台NVIDIA H20上的发电机空闲率从318.74s减少到5.83s,实现54.67美元\时间只限发电机速度. 推论代码和生成演示可在https://github.com/thu-ml/TurboDifunus/tree/main/turbot2va查询.

articles.title: ReGround-Surg: Reliability-Guided Anchor Grounding for Referring Surgical Video Segmentation
articles.content: Referring surgical video segmentation requires segmenting a target instrument or tissue region across video frames according to a natural language expression. Recent Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) based two-stage methods (e.g., ReSurgSAM2) first ground the referred target in an initial or selected frame, then propagate the selected mask via tracking. Although effective, their performance is highly sensitive to the quality of the initial grounded mask: once an incorrect anchor is selected, subsequent tracking tends to propagate the error. This issue is especially challenging in surgical videos due to visually similar instruments, occlusion, and complex tissue-tool interactions. To address this issue, we propose ReGround-Surg, a lightweight reliability-guided anchor grounding framework to improve SAM2-based referring surgical video segmentation. It first predicts a text-conditioned spatial reliability map from the referring expression and current-frame visual features. The map is then reused in two complementary branches: a Gated Side Adapter enhances expression-relevant visual regions before text-to-vision fusion, while a Reliability-Weighted Vision-to-Text Attention module suppresses off-target visual evidence during prompt-token aggregation. Experiments on Ref-EndoVis17 and Ref-EndoVis18 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods across three evaluation splits with negligible speed reduction. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/JiaxinWen1/ReGround-Surg.

articles.title_zh: ReGround-Surg: 参考外科视频分片的可靠引导锚地定位
articles.content_zh: 转录手术视频分解需要按照自然语言表达方式将目标仪器或组织区域分解到跨视频帧. 最近的片段 Anything Model 2(SAM2)基于两阶段方法(如ReSurgSAM2),首先在初始或选定框中打下被提及的目标,然后通过跟踪传播所选定的面具. 虽然效果有效,但他们的性能对初始被锚面具的质量高度敏感:一旦选择了不正确的锚,后续跟踪往往会传播错误. 由于视觉上相似的仪器、闭塞和复杂的组织工具相互作用,这个问题在手术录像中尤其具有挑战性。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议采用ReGround-Surg这一轻量级可靠性导锚定位框架,以改进基于SAM2的转录外科视频分区。 它首先从参考表达式和当前框架的视觉特征中预测一个文本条件的空间可靠性地图. 然后在两个互补分支中重新使用该地图:一个Gated Side适配器在文本到视觉聚变之前增强表达相关视觉区域,而一个Renecity-Wighted Vision-to-Text Recent 模块在即时调和过程中压制非目标视觉证据. 关于参考文件17和参考文件的实验 Vis18显示,在三种评价中,在减速可忽略不计的情况下,与最新方法相比,持续改进。 代码可在https://github.com/JiaxinWen1/ReGround-Surg上公开查阅.

articles.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation in Diffusion Models
articles.content: Reinforcement learning can align diffusion models with human preferences and task-specific objectives, but endpoint rewards do not specify how an intermediate denoising prediction should change. We introduce DiffusionOPSD as an on-policy self-distillation framework that converts image-level reward guidance into explicit targets for clean-output predictions at sampled queries. At each outer iteration, a frozen behavior policy generates trajectories and supplies query states and anchors. Reward gradients construct bounded positive and negative targets around each anchor. The trainable policy fits these targets as detached supervision through finite fitting before an exponential moving average update refreshes the behavior policy. This setup lets us measure target construction and finite realization separately. Controlled same-query experiments show that larger target-construction gains do not necessarily translate into larger realized gains after a single fitting update. Across SD 3.5-M and the step-distilled Z-Image-Turbo, our approach achieves the best final held-out scores in 19 of 20 reward-matched settings across two backbones and ten evaluators. It outperforms the strongest competing method by up to 44.0% and reduces training GPU-hours relative to DiffusionNFT by 40% on SD 3.5-M and 63% on Z-Image-Turbo. These results support on-policy self-distillation as an efficient and analyzable approach to diffusion post-training by converting image-level reward guidance into explicit and continually refreshed intermediate supervision, thereby opening a path toward more efficient and diagnosable alignment.

articles.title_zh: 扩散模式中的政策上的自我分散
articles.content_zh: 强化学习可以使传播模式与人类的偏好和特定任务目标相一致,但终点奖励并没有具体说明中间的去名预测应如何改变. 我们引入了传播OPSD作为政策性自我消化框架,将图像级奖励指导转化为在抽样查询时进行清洁产出预测的明确目标。 在每个外迭时,冻结的行为政策会产生轨迹和供给查询状态和锚. 奖励梯度围绕每个锚构造有界限的正负目标. 可训练政策与这些目标相匹配,在指数化移动平均更新更新更新行为政策之前,通过有限安装进行独立的监督。 这种设置让我们可以分别衡量目标构建和有限的实现. 受控的同温性实验表明,更大的目标建设收益不一定在一次适当更新后转化为更大的已实现收益。 在SD 3.5-M和继而消退的Z-Image-Turbo中,我们的方法在20个奖励匹配的设置中,在两个骨干和10个评价者中,在19个设置中,取得了最佳的最终悬赏分. 它比最强的竞技方法高44.0%,在SD3.5-M和Z-Image-Turbo上将GPU小时相对于DifmusionNFT的训练减少40%。 这些成果支持在政策上自我消化,作为一种高效和可分析的办法,通过将图像级奖励指导转化为明确和不断更新的中间监督,传播培训后的培训,从而为更有效和可诊断的调整开辟了道路。

articles.title: Towards Reliable AI-Based Histological Staining: A Systematic Study of Scaling and Uncertainty in Unpaired Generative Models
articles.content: Liver fibrosis, the principal predictor of long-term outcome in chronic liver disease, is staged from histological estimates of collagen content. Sirius Red (SR) provides the standard quantitative readout (collagen proportionate area, CPA) but is not acquired at every clinical centre and consumes tissue, time, and reagent cost beyond the routine Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stain. AI-based virtual staining can generate SR directly from H&E, yet systematic benchmarks of unsupervised models are scarce and their predictive uncertainty has not been quantified, even though visually plausible outputs may not faithfully reproduce the underlying tissue structure. We therefore benchmark six unsupervised image-to-image architectures (GAN-based and diffusion-based) across 54 scaling configurations on a newly released paired H&E to SR mouse liver dataset, the first open resource for this translation task. Each configuration is evaluated jointly on perceptual, distributional, and task-specific axes plus a blinded expert reader study; the best per family is then retrained as a deep ensemble, the first systematic comparison of epistemic uncertainty across unsupervised stain-to-stain architectures. Across families, perceptual quality, task-specific error, and ensemble agreement measure largely independent axes of model fitness: GAN-based methods cluster tightly on perceptual metrics yet differ substantially on task error and ensemble agreement, while the diffusion-based method (CycleDiffusion) is qualitatively different on all three. No single metric captures these differences, so reliable virtual staining requires reporting and selecting on all three jointly. The dataset, tiling pipeline, models, and evaluation code are released publicly.

articles.title_zh: 走向可靠的基于人工智能的历史学 封存:关于未确定基因模型的放大和不确定性的系统研究
articles.content_zh: 肝脏纤维化是慢性肝脏疾病中长期结果的主要预测者,由对胆固醇含量的组织学估计而来。 Sirius Red(SR)提供标准的定量读取(collagen比例区域,CPA),但并非在每个临床中心获得,消耗的组织,时间和试剂成本超出了常规的血氧林和eosin(H&E)污点. 基于AI的虚拟污渍可以直接从H&E生成SR,然而,无监督模型的系统基准很少,其预测不确定性也没有量化,尽管视觉上可信的输出可能无法忠实地复制基本的组织结构. 因此,我们以新发布的H&E配对到SR鼠标肝脏数据集为基准,将54个缩放配置的6个无监督的图像到图像架构(基于GAN和传播)作为基准,这是这一翻译任务的第一个开放资源. 每种配置都通过感知轴,分布轴和任务特异性轴加上盲目专家阅读器研究进行联合评价;然后每个家族最好的一个被重新训练为深层综艺,这是对无监督的污点到污点建筑的感知不确定性的第一次系统比较. 纵观全家,知觉质量,任务特异性错误,综艺协议衡量模式健身基本独立轴: 基于全球网络的方法紧紧地集中在感知度量度上,但在任务误差和共聚协议方面却大不相同,而基于扩散的方法(CycleDifmation)在质量上在所有三个方面都是不同的. 没有单一的衡量标准能够捕捉到这些差异,因此可靠的虚拟污渍需要报告,并共同选择所有三种。 数据集,平板管道,模型,评价代码公开发布.

articles.title: Comparative Assessment of Deep Learning Architectures for Underwater Subsurface Kelp Forest Segmentation with The Kelp-o-Tron
articles.content: Submerged kelp forests are vital coastal ecosystems that support marine biodiversity and ecosystem dynamics, yet accurate underwater kelp segmentation remains challenging due to optical degradation, illumination variability, turbidity, overlapping vegetation, and complex benthic backgrounds. We systematically evaluated three deep learning semantic segmentation frameworks, ResNet34-U-Net, ResNet50-DeepLabV3, and a hybrid ResNet50-ASPP-Transformer architecture, for kelp detection using high-resolution underwater RGB imagery collected from northeastern U.S. coastal waters. A dataset of 3,395 SSeg assisted annotated image-mask pairs was developed for model training and validation, while geographically independent sites were used for quantitative and qualitative evaluation. All models used consistent preprocessing, augmentation, and evaluation protocols. On independent test data, ResNet50-DeepLabV3 achieved the highest Dice (0.7120) and Intersection over Union (IoU; 0.6267), followed by ResNet34 U Net (Dice 0.6868; IoU 0.5978). The hybrid ASPP Transformer achieved the highest pixel accuracy (0.8528) but lower Dice (0.6437) and IoU (0.5746). External qualitative evaluation further showed that DeepLabV3 produced more consistent segmentation across varying environmental conditions, image qualities, and benthic habitats. Overall, ResNet50-DeepLabV3, termed Kelp-O-Tron, provided the best balance of segmentation accuracy, robustness, and generalization. The dataset, annotation workflow, and comparative evaluation provide resources for advancing automated underwater habitat mapping and ecological monitoring.

articles.title_zh: 与Kelp-o-Tron进行水下凯尔普地下森林分割深层学习结构比较评估
articles.content_zh: 水下海藻森林是支持海洋生物多样性和生态系统动态的重要沿海生态系统,但由于光学退化、光照变异、混凝土、植被重叠和复杂的海底背景,准确的海底海藻分化仍然具有挑战性。 我们系统评价了三个深层学习语义分解框架,即ResNet34-U-Net、ResNet50-DeepLabV3和一个混合的ResNet50-ASPP-Transformer架构,以便利用从美国东北沿海水域采集的高分辨率水下RGB图像进行海藻探测。 为模型培训和验证开发了3,395个SSeg辅助附加说明的图像掩码对数据集,同时利用地理上独立的站点进行定量和定性评价。 所有模型都使用了一致的预处理、增强和评价协议。 在独立测试数据上,ResNet50-DeepLabV3实现了最高的Dice(0.7120)和跨联盟(IoU;0.6267),其次是ResNet34 U Net(0.6868;IoU 0.5978). 混合式ASPP变形器实现了最高的像素精度(0.8528),但下第斯(0.6437)和IoU(0.5746). 外部质量评价进一步表明,DeepLabV3在不同的环境条件、图像质量和底栖生境方面产生了更加一致的分化。 总体而言,ResNet50-DeepLabV3,称为Kelp-O-Tron,提供了分区准确性、稳健性和概括性的最佳平衡。 数据集、注释工作流程和比较评价为推进水下生境自动测绘和生态监测提供了资源。

articles.title: Human-Inspired Social Engagement Analysis via Interpretable Mutual Visual Attention
articles.content: Understanding social interactions from non-verbal visual data is important for behavior analysis and activity monitoring. We propose an interpretable computational model of social engagement inspired by psychological theories of mutual visual attention. Rather than learning interaction patterns end-to-end, our framework explicitly models dyadic visual attention and aggregates these cues into interpretable measures of individual and group engagement. The resulting modular framework combines state-of-the-art head orientation estimation with lightweight geometric reasoning, producing explanations that remain accessible to non-technical users. We evaluate the proposed approach on a variety of data through quantitative experiments and demonstrate its practical usefulness with qualitative visualizations designed to support teachers, caregivers, and social workers in understanding group interaction dynamics.

articles.title_zh: 通过可解释的相互视觉关注进行人类启迪的社会参与分析
articles.content_zh: 从非语言视觉数据中了解社会互动对于行为分析和活动监测很重要. 我们提出了一个可解释的社会参与的计算模型,其灵感来自相互视觉关注的心理理论。 我们的框架不是学习互动模式的端到端,而是明确地将dyadic视觉注意力和这些提示汇总到个人和团体参与的可解释度量中。 由此产生的模块化框架将最先进的头部定向估计与轻量级几何推理相结合,产生非技术用户仍可获取的解释. 我们通过定量实验来评价关于各种数据的拟议方法,并用定性可视化展示其实用性,旨在支持教师、护理人员和社会工作者了解群体互动动态。

articles.title: X-MULTI: VLM-based Imaging Factor Disentanglement for Factor-Aware Image Synthesis
articles.content: Imaging factor disentanglement in text-to-image generation aims to independently control image acquisition properties such as types of camera lenses, sensor types, viewpoints, and domains to enable combinatorial generalization. This should let the model synthesize novel factor combinations unobserved in the training data, such as pairing a fisheye lens with an event sensor never observed in training data. Recent work, MULTI, introduced learnable, factor-specific embeddings to disentangle imaging factors, along with the Factor Alignment Accuracy (FAA) metric to evaluate disentanglement quality. We identify and address two independent limitations. First, MULTI's pixel-level reconstruction objective supervises the model only on observed imaging factor combinations, providing no direct training signal for novel combinations. We therefore propose X-MULTI, which uses a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) to supervise novel factor combinations synthesized during training. Second, we show the FAA metric exhibits severe cross-factor correlation leakage, misrepresenting true disentanglement quality. We therefore propose Improved-FAA (I-FAA), which employs factor-specific augmentation strategies to break these correlations and enables more rigorous evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that X-MULTI achieves improved factor alignment on novel combinations compared to MULTI. Moreover, we show that correlation leakage in FAA distorts the evaluation of true factor disentanglement and I-FAA reduces this leakage and therefore provides a more robust assessment of factor alignment.

articles.title_zh: X- MULTI:基于 VLM 成像因子分离用于因子- 智能图像合成
articles.content_zh: 成像因子在文本到图像生成中脱节,旨在独立控制图像获取属性,如相机镜头的类型,传感器类型,视角,和域,以便实现组合式泛化. 这将使模型合成培训数据中未观察到的新因素组合,例如将鱼眼镜头与培训数据中从未观察到的事件传感器配对。 最近的工作,即MULTI,引入了可学习的、针对具体因素的嵌入物,以分散成像因子,同时引入了用于评价分散性质量的Findem Union精确度(FAA)度量衡. 我们确定并解决两个独立的局限性。 首先,MULTI的像素级重建目标只监督模型在观测到的成像因子组合上,没有为新颖组合提供直接的训练信号. 因此,我们提出X-MULTI,它使用预先训练的视觉语言模型(VLM)来监督在训练中合成的新因素组合. 第二,我们显示FAA的度量显示 严重的跨因子关联泄漏, 扭曲真正的分散质量。 因此,我们提议采用针对具体因素的增强战略,打破这些关联,并能够进行更严格的评价。 实验证明,X-MULTI比MULTI在小说组合上实现了更好的因子对齐. 此外,我们显示,FAA中的关联性渗漏会扭曲对真正因子脱节的评价,I-FAA会减少这种渗漏,因此能对因子一致性进行更强有力的评估.

articles.title: KLTNet: Learning Sparse Feature Tracking for Robust and Accurate Monocular Visual-Inertial Odometry
articles.content: Many feature-based visual-inertial odometry (VIO) systems rely on sparse feature tracking, whose accuracy and robustness directly affect state estimation. Classical KLT trackers rely primarily on local image patches and can become unreliable under rapid motion or in low-texture environments. We propose KLTNet, a lightweight learning-based, plug-and-play sparse feature tracker designed to replace classical KLT trackers in KLT-based VIO front ends. KLTNet follows a coarse-to-fine, dense-to-sparse architecture that combines low-resolution dense optical flow for robust global motion initialization with triplet-patch refinement for accurate and temporally consistent tracking. A fixed reference patch provides a stable anchor throughout each feature track and helps reduce accumulated tracking drift. In addition, KLTNet predicts anisotropic confidence weights supervised through differentiable multi-view triangulation, which can be used as observation weights in compatible VIO estimators. Experiments with VINS-Mono and OpenVINS on public benchmarks and a self-collected low-texture dataset demonstrate improved tracking and odometry accuracy over classical KLT, while maintaining real-time performance on an embedded platform.

articles.title: Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation of SAM for Surgical Instrument Segmentation
articles.content: Surgical instrument segmentation (SIS) is fundamental for computer-assisted surgery, where reliable instrument masks enable precise scene understanding and clinical assistance. Recently, adapting foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to the surgical domain via prompt-learning has shown encouraging results. However, the performance of these adapted models under challenging surgical conditions is constrained by suboptimal adaptation mechanisms. Specifically, optimizing prompts or prototypes purely via downstream segmentation loss tends to cause them to degenerate into task-specific parameters rather than serving as persistent, stable category memory, thereby degrading their robustness against complex intraoperative variations. Moreover, routing multi-scale visual cues through a single prompt pathway creates a bottleneck that hinders effective scale-matched coupling. To address these limitations, we propose HPMA, a Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation framework for SAM. Specifically, HPMA constructs a frozen, multi-scale visual prototype memory bank from annotated surgical scenes and integrates it into SAM's feature space using lightweight adapters to preserve stable category evidence. To maximize the utility of multi-scale cues, we introduce a scale-matched coupling mechanism where global prototypes calibrate class-level prompt features, structural prototypes guide decoder object queries, and local prototypes align high-resolution feature maps through a local alignment objective. Extensive experiments on the public EndoVis2017 and EndoVis2018 datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing foundation model adaptation methods.

articles.title_zh: 用于外科仪器分离的 SAM 的分级原型-记忆改造
articles.content_zh: 外科仪器分解(SIS)对于计算机辅助外科手术至关重要,其中可靠的仪器口罩能够准确理解场景和临床协助. 最近,通过即时学习,使“任何部分模型”等基础模型适应手术领域,取得了令人鼓舞的成果。 然而,这些经过改造的模型在具有挑战性的外科手术条件下的性能受到不理想的适应机制的限制. 具体地说,纯粹通过下游分解损失而优化导体或原型,往往会使它们退化成特定任务参数,而不是作为持久、稳定的类别记忆,从而降低它们相对于复杂的操作内变体的强性。 此外,通过一个单一的快速通道来引导多尺度的视觉提示,会形成一个瓶颈,阻碍有效的比例比对耦合。 为了消除这些局限性,我们提议采用HPMA,作为SAM的分级原型-记忆适应框架。 具体而言,HPMA从附加说明的外科手术场景中构建了一个冷冻的,多尺度的视觉原型记忆库,并将其整合到SAM的特性空间中,使用轻量级适配器来保存稳定的类别证据. 为了最大限度地发挥多尺度提示的效用,我们引入了一个比例匹配的耦合机制,即全球原型校准类级即时特性,结构原型指导解码器对象查询,本地原型通过局部对齐目标对齐高分辨率特征图. 对公众EndoVis2017和EndoVis2018数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法实现了最先进的性能,优于现有基础模型的适应方法.

articles.title: VizAnchor: Decoding Manipulation Intent from Tampering Visualizations via Dual-Anchor Reasoning
articles.content: Data visualizations are widely used for communicating information, but they are also vulnerable to intentional manipulations that induce misleading interpretations. Existing methods focus on locating tampered regions or recovering hidden information, without explaining how the visualization has been manipulated or why the resulting changes may mislead viewers. We propose \textbf{VizAnchor}, a framework for visualization manipulation understanding through dual-anchor evidence construction and VLM-based reasoning. In the first stage, VizAnchor constructs a semantic anchor to recover authentic chart information and a spatial anchor to localize tampered regions. In the second stage, three specialized agents decode the manipulation. The misleader grounding agent analyzes a four-panel visual prompt to predict the misleader information. The chart narrative reconstruction agent takes the original and tampered charts as inputs and reconstructs their respective visual narratives. Finally, the intent inferring agent integrates the visual evidence and misleader information to infer the misleading intent. We further construct a dataset for tampering localization and a dataset for misleading intent inferring. Evaluation shows that VizAnchor accurately localizes manipulations and produces faithful explanations of their manipulation, misleaders, and misleading intents.

articles.title_zh: VizAnchor:从Tampering可视化中通过双Ancur-Reasoning解码操纵图谋
articles.content_zh: 数据可视化被广泛用于传递信息,但也容易受到有意操纵,诱发误导性解释. 现有方法侧重于查找篡改区域或恢复隐藏信息,而没有解释可视化是如何被操纵的,或者由此产生的变化可能误导观众的原因. 我们提出\textbf{VizAnchor},一个通过双源证据构建和基于VLM的推理实现可视化操纵理解的框架. 在第一阶段,VizAnchor构建了一个语义锚,以回收真实的图表信息和一个空间锚,以将篡改的区域本地化. 第二阶段,三名专业特工解码操纵. 误导者搁浅代理分析一个四层的视觉提示来预测误导者的信息. 图表叙事重建代理人将原版和篡改的图表作为投入,重建各自的视觉叙事. 最后,意向推断代理人将视觉证据和误导者信息整合为推断误导意图. 我们进一步构建一个用于篡改本地化的数据集和一个用于误导意图推断的数据集. 评价显示,VizAnchor精确地将操纵本地化,并产生对其操纵,误导者和误导意图的忠实解释.

articles.title: It depends: Incorporating correlations for joint aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties of high-dimensional output spaces
articles.content: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) plays a vital role in enhancing the reliability of deep learning model predictions, especially in scenarios with high-dimensional output spaces. This paper addresses the dual nature of uncertainty -- aleatoric and epistemic -- focusing on their joint integration in high-dimensional regression tasks. For example, in applications like medical image segmentation or restoration, aleatoric uncertainty captures inherent data noise, while epistemic uncertainty quantifies the model's confidence in unfamiliar conditions. Modeling both jointly enables more reliable predictions by reflecting both unavoidable variability and knowledge gaps, whereas modeling only one limits transparency and robustness. We propose a novel approach that approximates the resulting joint uncertainty using a low-rank plus diagonal covariance structure, capturing essential output correlations while avoiding the computational burdens of full covariance matrices. Unlike prior work, our method explicitly combines aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties into a unified second-order distribution that supports robust downstream analyses like sampling and log-likelihood evaluation. We further introduce stabilization strategies for efficient training and inference, achieving superior UQ in the tasks of image inpainting, colorization, optical flow, and depth estimation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 这取决于: 将高维输出空间的共感和感知不确定性关联起来
articles.content_zh: 不确定性量化(UQ)在提高深层学习模型预测的可靠性方面发挥着至关重要的作用,特别是在具有高维输出空间的情景中. 本文论述不确定性的双重性质 -- -- 厌食性和认知性 -- -- 重点是将它们联合纳入高维回归任务。 例如,在医学图像分解或恢复等应用中,厌食不确定性会捕捉固有数据噪声,而感官不确定性则会量化模型在不熟悉条件下的信心. 联合建模既能反映不可避免的变异性,又能反映知识差距,从而能够作出更可靠的预测,而建模仅能限制透明度和稳健性。 我们建议采用一种新颖的方法,采用低级和对角共变结构来大致估计由此产生的共同不确定性,捕捉基本产出相关性,同时避免完全共变矩阵的计算负担。 与以前的工作不同,我们的方法明确将机能和感官不确定性结合起来,形成统一的二阶分布,支持强力的下游分析,如采样和类似日志评价. 我们进一步推行稳定战略,以便进行有效的培训和推论,在图像涂抹、色化、光学流动和深度估计等任务中达到更高的UQ。

articles.title: Model Effect or Label Effect? Refined Annotations and a Human-Referenced Benchmark for Pulmonary Embolism Segmentation
articles.content:
Purpose: To quantify how evaluation annotations influence measured pulmonary embolism (PE) segmentation performance relative to model training changes, and to establish a human-referenced framework.
  Materials and Methods: This retrospective study screened 166 voxel-annotated CT pulmonary angiography cases from CADPE (n=91), FUMPE (n=35), and READ (n=40); 149 were included. A primary rater annotated PE by protocol, and a senior thoracic radiologist reviewed and revised all segmentations. Three additional raters at three centers annotated a 15-case subset. The label effect was measured by evaluating two pretrained nnU-Net models (nnU-Net-A, nnU-Net-B) against original and refined annotations. The model effect was measured by comparing the same architecture trained on different dataset combinations with annotations fixed. The benchmark model (nnPE) was trained with leave-one-dataset-out and pooled five-fold cross-validation. Four metric categories were analyzed with case-paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and bootstrap 95% CIs.
  Results: Changing only the annotation increased mean DSC by 0.143 (0.122-0.166) for nnU-Net-A and 0.188 (0.163-0.213) for nnU-Net-B (both P < .001), whereas changing training-dataset composition changed DSC by 0.028. The label effect exceeded the model effect on CADPE and FUMPE and was 0.045 on READ. Within-mask attenuation SD fell in all three datasets after re-annotation (all P < .001). nnPE reached DSC 0.72 +/- 0.22 on pooled cross-validation but scored below all four annotators across 52 paired comparisons (all corrected P < .05).
  Conclusion: Evaluation annotations affected measured PE segmentation performance at least as much as model training choices. A human-referenced evaluation framework is publicly available for future study.

articles.title_zh: 模型效应还是标签效应? 精炼说明和人对肺栓塞的基准
articles.content_zh:
目的: 量化评价说明对衡量肺栓塞(PE)分解性能的影响与模型训练变化的对比,并建立人参考框架.
材料和方法: 本次回顾性研究从CADPE(n=91)、FUMPE(n=35)和READ(n=40)中筛选了166个输卵管肺血管造影病例;其中包括149个。 一名按协议附加说明的初级评定员和一名高级胸腔放射学家审查并修订了所有分解。 3个中心的另外3名评分员 附加了15个案例 衡量标签效果的方法是对照原文和精细的说明,评价两个预先训练的nnU-Net模型(nnU-Net-A,nnU-Net-B). 模型效果的衡量是通过将不同数据集组合上训练的相同架构与说明固定进行比较. 基准模型(NNPE)接受了一个数据集和五倍集合交叉验证的培训。 四个公尺的类别 被分析 案件发包的Wilcoxon签名排名测试, Benjamini-Hochberg 校正, 和靴套95%的CI。
结果: 只修改注解就增加了NNU-Net-A的DSC0.143(0.122-0.166)和NNU-Net-B(均为P < 001)的0.188(0.163-0.213),而改变培训数据集的组成则改变了DSC的0.028。 标签效果超过了CADPE和FUMPE的模型效果,在READ上为0.045. 在再次说明(所有P <.001)后,所有三个数据集中都降入了任务内衰减SD。 NDPE在集合交叉验证上达到DSC 0.72 +/- 0.22,但通过52对比(所有更正的P <.05),得分低于所有四个注释者。
结论:评价说明至少与示范培训选择一样,对项目执行部门划分的绩效进行了衡量。 可供今后研究的参考评价框架已经公开。

articles.title: Low-Rank Ternary Adaptation for Fine-Tuning Transformers
articles.content: Ternary transformers offer extreme memory and compute efficiency, but existing low-bit LoRA-based methods cannot directly fine-tune ternary weights. Current approaches either require dequantization, restoring low-bit base weights to higher precision to merge with adaptation weight, or update only quantization parameters, preventing a merged model that remains ternary. We propose ternary multiplicative adaptation, which represents discrete updates of ternary weights such as sign flips or zeroing through a low-rank Kronecker factorization into two small ternary matrices applied element-wise to ternary weights. This design is parameter-efficient and expressive, preserves the ternary domain, and supports direct merging without dequantization. Experiments on six models across language and vision, including ternarized LLaMA-3 1B and 3B and a ternary ViT-B/16, demonstrate that our method recovers much of the performance lost to quantization and outperforms strong low-bit and ternary baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/alexmanoo/ternary_adaptation.

articles.title_zh: 用于精致变形器的低Rank 第三级适应
articles.content_zh: 三级变压器提供了极强的内存和计算效率,但现有的低位LORA基方法不能直接微调三重. 目前的方法要么要求去位化,将低位基重恢复到更高的精度以与适应重量合并,要么只更新定量参数,防止合并模型仍为立方体. 我们提出三元多态性适应,它代表三元重量的离散更新,例如通过低级的Kronecker因子化将标志翻转或零化,形成两个小的三元矩阵,按元素对三元重量进行应用。 这种设计具有参数效率和表达性,保留了ternary域,并支持不分化的直接合并. 对6种跨语言和视觉模型的实验,包括三角化LLaMA-3 1B和3B以及一个三角化的VIT-B/16,表明我们的方法恢复了大量因量化而丧失的性能,并且超过了强的低位和三角基线. 代码可见于https://github.com/alexmanoo/ternary_adaptation.

articles.title: DoublesEval: Diagnosing Multi-Agent Tactical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Professional Doubles Badminton
articles.content: Visual Language Models (VLMs) excel at describing visible scene content but struggle to reason about dynamic multi-agent interactions, where action semantics depend on coordinated roles and spatial-temporal dependencies. We formalize this capability as \textbf{multi-agent tactical reasoning} and introduce \textbf{DoublesEval}, a diagnostic evaluation framework that leverages professional doubles badminton as a structurally tractable testbed. DoublesEval employs a key-moment-based protocol that decomposes rallies into tactically salient instants and probes models across four interpretable dimensions: atomic recognition, intra-segment composite understanding, cross-segment causal reasoning, and high-level tactical abstraction. This design isolates \emph{where} reasoning fails, rather than merely measuring answer correctness. To address observed failure modes, we propose \textbf{TacticCheck}, a lightweight constraint-guided test-time consistency checker that reranks candidate answers using the model's own lower-level tactical predictions, requiring no parameter updates or ground-truth labels at inference time. Evaluating four representative open-source VLMs on 60 curated rallies (yielding $\sim$9.6K structured instances) via a zero-shot protocol, we find that models remain weak across all diagnostic levels, with especially clear bottlenecks in spatial state, interaction binding, and terminal evidence. TacticCheck delivers consistent gains across all evaluated models, while still leaving a substantial gap to robust tactical reasoning. These results highlight the need for structured, interaction-aware evaluation paradigms for next-generation VLMs. The source code is available in \href{https://github.com/Chengjt1999/DoublesEval}{\textcolor{blue}{our GitHub repository}}.

articles.title_zh: DoublesEval:通过专业双人羽毛球在视觉-语言模型中诊断多代理战术理由
articles.content_zh: Visual Language Models (VLMs) 擅长描述可见的场景内容,但为动态的多剂相互作用而挣扎理性,其中动作语义依赖于协调的角色和空间-时空依赖. 我们把这个能力正式化为\textbf{多代理战术推理}并引入\textbf{DoublesEval},这个诊断性评价框架利用专业双人羽毛球作为结构可携带的测试床. 双倍 Eval采用了一个基于键动的协议,将集合分解为战术突出的瞬间,并探索了四个可解释维度的模型:原子识别,片段内复合理解,跨片段因果推理,以及高级战术抽象. 此设计隔离\ emph{ where} 推理失败, 而不是仅仅测量答案正确性 。 为了解决观察到的故障模式,我们提议\textbf{战术检查},一个轻量级约束制导的测试时间一致性检查器,使用模型本身的低级战术预测重新排序候选答案,在推断时间不需要参数更新或地面真实标签. 通过零镜头协议, 对60场有代表性的公开源码集会(产生9.6K美元结构化实例)评价四个具有代表性的公开源码(VLM), 我们发现模型在所有诊断级别上仍然薄弱, " 战术检查 " 在所有被评价的模型中都取得了一致的成果,同时仍然留下很大差距,只能进行有力的战术推理。 这些成果突出表明,需要为下一代的甚高频评价制定有条理、有互动意识的评价范式。 源代码见\href{https://github.com/Chengjt1999/DoublesEval\textcolor{blue}{our> GitHub 仓库。

articles.title: Vision Language Model Fusion for Explainable Face Recognition
articles.content:
Responsible deployment of face verification systems requires more than accurate decisions: systems should also provide interpretable and auditable evidence that enables users to understand, assess, and challenge their decisions. Vision-language models (VLMs) provide a promising foundation for explainable face recognition by combining visual analysis with natural-language reasoning. However, relying on a single model may further limit the decision accuracy as well as provided explanations. This work therefore investigates whether multiple VLMs can be combined to improve recognition accuracy, and to enrich the explanations associated with those decisions. This work evaluates four VLMs as standalone face verification systems and subsequently proposes a fusion framework, where two source models provide similarity scores and textual justifications and a third VLM acts as a decider model. Four different fusion scenarios are considered, progressively providing the decider model with scores, justifications, face images, and combinations of these modalities.
  Overall, the findings suggest that the value of multi-VLM fusion extends beyond recognition performance. VLMs can provide complementary justifications and perspectives that enable richer explanations of face recognition decisions, supporting greater transparency, auditability, and error analysis. This is relevant to the development of responsible explainable face verification systems, where users and operators should be able to understand not only the final decision but also the evidence and potential sources underlying it. The proposed multimodal VLM, which combines decision scores, explanations, and face images, achieves higher recognition accuracy than state-of-the-art VLMs and domain-specific face recognition models, while also providing fused explanations that are expected to be more robust than those generated by individual VLMs.

articles.title_zh: 用于解释性面部识别的视觉语言模型聚合
articles.content_zh:
负责任地部署面孔核查系统需要的不仅仅是准确的决定:系统还应提供可解释和可审计的证据,使用户能够理解、评估和质疑其决定。 视觉语言模型(VLMs)通过将视觉分析与自然语言推理相结合,为可解释的面部识别提供了一个很有希望的基础. 然而,依赖单一模式可能会进一步限制决定的准确性以及提供的解释。 因此,这项工作调查了能否将多种自愿识别标准结合起来以提高识别准确性,并丰富与这些决定相关的解释。 这项工作评价了四个VLM作为独立的面部核查系统,随后提出了一个聚变框架,其中两个源模型提供了相似性分数和文字理由,第三个VLM充当决定模型. 考虑了四种不同的聚变方案,逐步为决定者模型提供分数,理由,面像,以及这些模式的组合.
总的来说,调查结果表明,多VLM聚变的价值超出了识别性能. 自愿清单可以提供补充理由和观点,从而能够更充分地解释面部识别决定,支持提高透明度、可审计性和错误分析。 这与发展负责任的可解释的面孔核查系统有关,用户和操作人员应不仅能够了解最后决定,而且能够了解决定所依据的证据和潜在来源。 拟议的多模式VLM结合了决定分数,解释和面部图像,实现了比最先进的VLM和特定域面部识别模型更高的识别精度,同时也提供了预计比单个VLM生成的更坚固的引信解释.

articles.title: Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation
articles.content: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has been widely concerned in the fields of machine learning, pattern recognition, and computer vision. Traditional UDA learning usually assumes that the label spaces of the source and target domains are exactly the same and only needs to solve the problem of sample distribution drift existing between two domains. However, in real world applications, the label spaces between two domains may be different. In this case, there are both sample distribution drift and class spatial difference between domains, namely Universal Domain Adaptation (UniDA) learning scenario. At present, existing works rarely offer theoretical analysis for universal domain adaptation. In this paper, we provide an upper bound of the generalization error for universal domain adaptation. According to the proposed generalization error bound, we propose a novel UniDA algorithm called Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation (JAUA), which aligns the joint distributions by minimizing the distribution discrepancy calculated by Chi-Square divergence. Furthermore, we propose a progressive pseudo-labeling method to assign the pseudo labels to unlabeled target samples. The experiment results on six public image datasets demonstrate the superiority of JAUA in handling the UniDA problem.

articles.title_zh: 通用域适应联合分配调整
articles.content_zh: 无监督域适应(UDA)在机器学习,图案识别,以及计算机视觉等领域受到广泛关注. 传统的UDA学习通常假设源域和目标域的标签空间完全相同,只需要解决两个域之间存在的样本分布漂移问题. 然而,在现实世界应用中,两个域之间的标签空间可能有所不同. 在这种情况下,域间既存在样本分布漂移,也存在类空间差异,即通用域适应(UniDA)学习情景. 目前,现有作品很少提供通用域适应的理论分析. 在本文中,我们为通用域适应提供了概括错误的上限. 根据拟议泛化错误绑定,我们提出一个名为UniDA算法(UniDA Agreement for Universal Domain University Adapitation (JAUA)),通过最小化Chi-Square difference计算出的分布差异来对联合分布进行校正. 此外,我们提出一种渐进的伪标签方法,将伪标签分配给未贴标签的目标样本。 实验结果在六个公共图像数据集上显示JAUA在处理UniDA问题上的优越性.

articles.title: ZODIAC: Zero-shot Octree-based Diffusion for Anatomical Completion
articles.content: Recovering the full 3D spine anatomy from intraoperative ultrasound is an ill-posed inverse problem, as the complete structure must be inferred from incomplete and noisy observations. Acoustic occlusions and limited field of view create large unobserved regions, while view-dependent artifacts lead to variability in expert annotations of the visible anatomy. Current supervised ultrasound shape completion methods rely on synthetically generated incomplete-complete paired data to learn conditional mappings under a predefined distribution of simulated occlusions. However, real intraoperative occlusions do not necessarily follow this distribution, which can limit generalization to patient data. As a result, accurate and robust completion from noisy partial observations remains an unsolved problem. We propose a zero-shot shape completion framework that reconstructs the entire lumbar spine from partial ultrasound observations without relying on simulated training data. To accommodate unseen and irregular patterns of missing structures, we introduce blended completion, a mechanism that integrates the learned anatomical prior with incoming partial geometry at inference time. The method learns a generative diffusion prior over full anatomical shapes represented in an adaptive octree structure, enabling efficient modeling of the complete spine in a single forward pass. Validation on phantom and volunteer data shows that decoupling completion from a predefined corruption distribution improves generalisation under real occlusions, outperforming a fully supervised variant by 22% on HD95 completion error. Code and data are available at https://github.com/miruna20/ZODIAC.

articles.title_zh: ZODIAC: 零射Octree 扩散用于解剖
articles.content_zh: 从手术内超声波中恢复完整的3D脊椎解剖是一个不适当的反向问题,因为整个结构必须从不完整和吵闹的观测中推断出来. 声学隔离和有限的视野形成了大片无人观察的区域,而视线依赖的文物则导致可见解剖学专家说明的变异. 目前受监督的超声波形状完成方法依赖合成生成的不完整的对称数据,在模拟隔离的预定义分布下学习有条件的映射. 然而,实际的手术内隔离不一定遵循这种分布,这可以限制对患者数据的概括. 因此,从吵闹的部分观察中准确和有力地完成工作仍然是一个未决问题。 我们提出一个零镜头形状完成框架,从部分超声波观测中重建整个腰椎,而不依赖于模拟训练数据. 为了适应缺失结构的不见和不规则的规律,我们引入了混合完成,一种在推论时将所学解剖学与即将到来的部分几何学融合在一起的机制. 该方法在以适应性的奥克特里结构为代表的全解剖形状之前,先学习基因扩散,使完整的脊椎在一次前传中能够有效建模。 对幽灵和志愿者数据的验证表明,将完成与预先界定的腐败分布脱钩有助于在实际隔离下进行概括,在HD95的完成错误上,一个完全监督的变体的表现比它高出22%。 代码和数据见https://github.com/miruna20/ZODIAC。

articles.title: MRI-based Deep Radiomic Phenotyping of Neuromuscular Disorders: A Topology-driven Characterization
articles.content: Quantitative assessment of muscle MRI is crucial for monitoring neuromuscular disorders (NMD). This study introduces an automated radiomic phenotyping framework based on original features engineered across five main architectural domains: quantitative morphometry, spatial distribution, geometric shape, interactions between progressive fat replacement stages, and graph-based topology. Utilizing 1184 MRI scans from the CoMPaSS-NMD project, we map the complex 3D architecture of heterogeneous intramuscular lipodegeneration into objective, morphologically interpretable biomarkers. We introduce a graph-based skeletonization of fat infiltrates to quantify muscle architectural changes, establishing a multi-dimensional extension of traditional, spatially-agnostic volume metrics by mapping topological networks across the entire 3D muscle volume. Statistical screening via non-parametric Kruskal-Wallis analysis confirmed the discriminative power of these novel descriptors across the genetic hierarchy. Notably, topological network metrics (e.g., SF1_Skel_Nodes, $ε^2$ = 0.2656) and interface dynamics metrics (e.g., SF2_To_SF1_Dist_Min, $ε^2$ = 0.2092) demonstrated substantial effect sizes, providing deeper structural insights than classical volumetric assessments. Post-hoc pairwise evaluations and UMAP projections further indicated the capability of these topological and 3D geometric invariants to capture disease-specific macroscopic infiltration patterns. These results demonstrate that global architectural features represent a highly promising class of biomarkers for differential diagnosis, offering new avenues for tracking longitudinal disease dynamics in neuromuscular diagnostics. The developed automated feature extraction pipeline is integrated and available within the MUSCAT (MUSCle fAt Topology) library.

articles.title_zh: 基于核磁共振的神经肌肉深层放射 障碍:地形学驱动的特征化
articles.content_zh: 对肌肉磁共振进行定量评估对监测神经肌肉疾病至关重要。 这项研究采用了一个自动化的放射线线圈框架,其基础是最初设计的特征,涉及五个主要建筑领域:定量摩尔几何学、空间分布、几何形状、渐进脂肪取代阶段之间的相互作用以及以图表为基础的地形学。 我们利用来自CompaSS-NMD项目的1 184个核磁共振扫描仪,将各种肌肉内脂代生成的复杂3D结构绘制成客观的、可形态解释的生物标记。 我们引入了以图表为基础的脂肪渗透骨架化,以量化肌肉建筑变化,通过绘制整个3D肌肉体积的地形网络图,建立了传统,空间不可知体积测量度量的多维延伸. 通过非参数化的Kruskal-Wallis分析进行统计筛选,证实了这些新的描述符在整个基因等级上的歧视性作用。 值得注意的是,地形网络计量(例如SF1_Skel_Nodes, $_2美元=0.2656)和接口动态计量(例如SF2_To_SF1_Dist_Min, $_2美元=0.2092)显示出很大的影响大小,提供了比经典体积评估更深层次的结构见解。 后双向评价和UMAP预测进一步表明这些地形学和三维几何变量能够捕捉特定疾病的宏观渗透模式。 这些结果显示,全球建筑特征是差异性诊断的非常有前途的生物标志,为跟踪神经肌肉诊断中的纵向疾病动态提供了新的途径。 开发的自动特性提取管道在MUSCAT(MUSSCle fat Topology)图书馆内集成并可供使用。

articles.title: Markerless Pose Estimation for Resistance Training Technique Assessment
articles.content: Resistance training can be a high risk activity, and safe form is essential to avoiding injury. Laboratory-based movement analysis provides quantitive technique assessment, yet is not easily accessible. Markerless pose estimation infers body landmarks from images or video without physical markers and could offer a feasible alternative for technique assessment. We present a pose estimation framework to evaluate resistance-training technique from ordinary video footage. Using BlazePose, anatomical landmarks were extracted from squat, bench press, and deadlift videos and converted into joint-angle trajectories, with the squat serving as the primary case study. Trajectories were assessed against a defined reference repetition using root mean square error (RMSE). Results show that the framework recovers meaningful kinematic patterns for the squat and deadlift, enabling quantitative comparison between repetitions and identification of technique variability within a set. Performance depended strongly on camera orientation and visual occlusion, with non-sagittal views distorting 2D joint-angle estimates. The findings demonstrate that markerless pose estimation can support accessible biomechanical assessment outside laboratory environments.

articles.title_zh: 抗药性培训技术评估的无标记松评价
articles.content_zh: 抵抗训练可能是一种高风险活动,安全形式对避免伤害至关重要。 以实验室为基础的运动分析提供了定量技术评估,但不容易获得。 无标值从图像或视频中推断出没有物理标记的身体地标,并可以为技术评估提供可行的替代办法。 我们提出一个姿势估计框架,从普通录像中评估抵抗训练技术。 利用BlazePose,从蹲板、板凳和吊车视频中提取解剖地标,并转换成联合角轨迹,以蹲板作为主要案例研究。 利用根平均平方差错(RMSE),对照定义的参考重复来评估轨迹. 结果表明,该框架恢复了蹲式和死式的有意义的运动模式,从而能够从数量上比较重复和确定一组技术的可变性。 性能强烈依赖于镜头定向和视觉闭塞,非斜视扭曲2D联角估计. 研究结果表明,无标记的估算可以支持实验室环境之外可获得的生物机械评估。

articles.title: Bridging Adversarial and Collaborative Learning for AI-Generated Image Quality Assessment
articles.content: AI-generated image quality assessment (AIGIQA) requires jointly reasoning about perceptual fidelity and prompt alignment, two quality dimensions that are often treated as independent in existing AIGIQA models. However, by re-examining human ratings, we uncover a previously overlooked phenomenon: the two dimensions are interdependent and exhibit both competitive and cooperative interactions during human rating. This observation suggests that a unified model should neither collapse the two dimensions nor rigidly separate them, but rather adaptively negotiate their interplay. Motivated by this insight, we introduce an interaction-aware learning framework that models perception-alignment relations through adversarial and collaborative inference pathways. Instead of designing a rigid dual-branch architecture, our method employs a gated interaction module that dynamically routes features according to the inferred relationship between the two dimensions. Task-aware prompts further modulate the gating behaviour, enabling the model to switch between competition and cooperation when necessary. Experiments across multiple AIGIQA benchmarks demonstrate that our approach not only achieves state-of-the-art accuracy but also yields interpretable interaction patterns, offering a more faithful approximation of human judgment. The codes are available at https://github.com/LQAMEI/ACL-IQA.

articles.title_zh: 为AI-Gened图像质量评估进行横向和协作学习
articles.content_zh: AI生成的图像质量评估(AIGIQA)要求对知觉忠诚性和即时对齐进行联合推理,这两个质量维度在现有的AIGIQA模型中往往被视为独立. 然而,通过重新审查人类的评级,我们发现了一个以前被忽视的现象:这两个层面是相互依存的,在人类评级过程中表现出竞争和合作的互动。 这一观点表明,一个统一的模型既不应崩溃两个层面,也不应僵硬地将它们分开,而应适应性地谈判其相互作用。 以这种见解为动力,我们引入了一个互动意识学习框架,通过对抗和合作的推论途径来模拟感知与调和的关系。 我们的方法不是设计一个僵硬的双分支结构,而是使用一个有门的相互作用模块,这个模块根据两个维度之间的推断关系,动态地引导特征. 对任务的认识促使人们进一步调整配给行为,使模式能够在必要时在竞争与合作之间转换。 跨越多个AIGIQA基准的实验表明,我们的方法不仅实现了最先进的准确性,而且得出了可解释的相互作用模式,为人类判断提供了更忠实的近似. 这些代码见https://github.com/LQAMEI/ACL-IQA。

articles.title: Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion for Robust End-to-End Driving under Asymmetric Sensor Degradation
articles.content: End-to-end multimodal driving has progressed rapidly by fusing camera and LiDAR streams. Existing pipelines remain fragile under asymmetric sensor degradation, where either an entire modality or only a localized region is corrupted while other regions remain useful. The key difficulty is not simply to add an uncertainty head, but to obtain dense reliability supervision, calibrate this reliability against physical fault severity, and use it before unreliable features bias the planner. We propose Variance-Guided Spatial Attention Fusion (VG-SAF), in which dense heteroscedastic reliability estimates act as interpretable spatial gates. The framework couples three components. First, a physically grounded augmentor simulates representative camera and LiDAR failures and emits a continuous spatial mask, providing dense supervision without additional annotation. Second, modality-specific experts predict per-pixel reliability scales through cross-branch dense distillation in log space, enforcing a monotone severity-to-scale response. Third, calibrated reliability maps drive a hybrid attention mechanism that suppresses unreliable cells with a local spatial gate and arbitrates between modalities through a cross-modal trust softmax. A Laplace uncertainty head emits a systemic waypoint uncertainty scale that signals severe or combined sensor degradation, including severities outside the training ranges. On the CARLA Longest6 benchmark, VG-SAF consistently improves closed-loop robustness over the baselines across camera-only, LiDAR-only, and joint degradation regimes, as measured by driving score, route completion, and infraction score.
