articles.title_zh: 在不对称传感器退化下强力终端至终端驱动的空间注意系数差异
articles.content_zh: 通过引信相机和LiDAR流,端到端的多式联运驱动迅速取得进展。 在不对称传感器退化的情况下,现有管道仍然很脆弱,在这种条件下,一个整体模式或仅仅是一个局部区域被腐蚀,而其他区域仍然有用。 关键困难不仅仅是要增加一个不确定头,而是要获得密集的可靠性监督,将这种可靠性校准为物理过失的严重程度,并在不可靠的特征偏向规划者之前使用. 我们提议以差异为导向的空间注意力融合(VG-SAF),其中密集的异质可靠性估计可用作可解释的空间门。 框架夫妇包括三个组成部分。 首先,一个实际安装的增强器模拟具有代表性的相机和LiDAR故障,并发出连续的空间罩,提供密集的监控而不附加注释. 第二,模式特定专家通过对木空间的跨分支密集蒸馏来预测每个像素的可靠性尺度,执行单酮重度对尺度的反应. 第三,校准的可靠性图驱动一种混合关注机制,通过一个跨模式信任软max压制带有局部空间门的不可靠的细胞,并在模式间进行仲裁.  Laplace 不确定性会发出一个系统的方法点不确定性尺度,表明传感器严重或综合退化,包括训练范围以外的断裂。 在CARLA Longest6基准上,VG-SAF在基线上持续改进闭路稳健性,跨越了仅摄像头、LiDAR和联合退化制度,其衡量标准是驾驶分数、路线完成率和违规分数。

articles.title: MaST: Motion-aware Sparse Pipeline for Lightweight Object Tracking
articles.content:
Transformer-based object trackers are renowned for their strong performance, yet dense token processing often leads to prohibitive computational cost, limiting real-time deployment on edge devices. While recent works explore token pruning to reduce computation, they often stop short of an end-to-end sparse pipeline, as early-layer token scores can be noisy without a motion prior, and many trackers ultimately fall back to dense reshaping to feed the dense prediction head that partially negates the savings.
  We introduce Motion-aware Sparse Tracker (MaST), a sparse tracking framework that makes sparsity effective from tokens to boxes. First, MaST injects a lightweight motion prior to refine cross-attention-based importance scores, enabling earlier and more stable token reduction in the search region. Second, we introduce a natively sparse prediction head that operates directly on the retained unstructured tokens with a score-first, regress-once design, eliminating dense padding/reshaping and reducing redundant computation.
  Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that MaST establishes new state of the art among lightweight trackers, where MaST-tiny attains 63.8 AUC on LaSOT and 80.1 SUC on TrackingNet, surpassing the prior best AsymTrack-S by +1.0 AUC and +2.2 SUC
  while running at 152 FPS on Jetson Nano, nearly twice as fast as AsymTrack-S at 88 FPS. Code is available at https://github.com/TsingWei/MaST.

articles.title_zh: MaST: 轻量级物体跟踪运动感光管道
articles.content_zh:
基于变形器的物体跟踪器以其强大的性能而闻名,然而密集的符号处理经常导致令人望而却步的计算成本,限制了在边缘设备上的实时部署. 近期的作品虽然探索了减少计算值的标志性推算,但经常会停止在末端至末端的稀疏输油管上,因为早期的标志性分数可以在没有运动前就发出噪音,许多跟踪器最终会回到密集的重塑中来喂食部分抵消节约的密集预测头.
我们引入了Motion-aware Sparse Tracker(英语:MaST),这是一个稀疏的跟踪框架,它使得Sparsity从信物到盒子都是有效的. 首先,MaST在精炼基于跨意向的重要性分数之前注入轻量级运动,使得搜索区域能够更早和更稳定的象征性减值. 第二,我们引入了一个本地稀疏的预测头,直接在保留下来的无结构符号上操作,并采用记分第一、倒置式设计,消除密集的粘贴/重塑,减少冗余计算。
对多种基准的广泛试验表明,MaST在轻量级跟踪器中建立了新的技术水平,其中MaST-tiny在LaSOT上达到63.8AUC,在跟踪网上达到80.1SUC,通过+1.0AUC和+2.2SUC超过了之前最好的AsymTrack-S.
在Jetson Nano上以152 FPS的速度运行时,快于AsymTrack-S88 FPS的近两倍. 代码见https://github.com/Tsingwei/MaST.

articles.title: B-MIM: Biased Masked Image Modeling for Generalizable Segmentation of Fine-Grained Anatomical Structures
articles.content: Self-supervised pretraining enables transferable representations for medical imaging, yet most CT encoders remain biased toward coarse semantic understanding, limiting their sensitivity to fine-grained anatomical structures such as vessels or small tumors. In this paper, we introduce Biased Masked Image Modeling (B-MIM), a modification of the iBOT objective that stochastically reduces global semantic alignment to prioritize local patch reconstruction. This bias encourages the encoder to capture high-frequency morphological details and structural continuity. We curate a multi-institutional CT abdominal dataset of 9,955 filtered studies from 17 public sources and pretrain a 3D Swin Transformer backbone using B-MIM. Across inter-dataset experiments on liver vessel segmentation, the proposed encoder improves topological fidelity (clDice) and achieves competitive Dice scores in tumor segmentation, compared to fully fine-tuned baselines, despite updating only a fraction of the parameters. Our results suggest that reducing global semantic pressure during pretraining enhances generalization to intricate anatomical structures.

articles.title_zh: B-MIM:精密解剖结构一般分解的斜面图像模型
articles.content_zh: 自我监督的预训可以使医学成像的表达可以转移,但大多数CT编码器仍然偏向粗糙的语义理解,将其灵敏度限制在细纹解剖结构上,如血管或小肿瘤. 在本文中,我们引入了Biased Masked图像建模(B-MIM),这是对iBOT目标的一种修改,该目标有条不紊地降低了全球语义一致,以优先进行局部补丁重建. 这种偏差鼓励编码器捕捉高频形态细节和结构连续性. 我们从17个公共来源整理了9 955个经过滤研究的多机构CT腹部数据集,并使用B-MIM预装了3D Swin Transformer骨干. 在肝脏容器分化的数据集间实验中,拟议的编码器改善了地形的忠心度(ClDice),在肿瘤分化方面实现了具有竞争力的Dice分数,与完全微调的基线相比,尽管只是更新了一小部分参数. 我们的结果表明,在预训期间减少全球语义压力,可增强对复杂解剖结构的概括。

articles.title: Metadata-Aware Adaptation of a Generative Foundation Model for Conditional CMR Synthesis
articles.content: Synthetic image generation is a promising strategy to address data scarcity and the underrepresentation of clinically important phenotypes in medical imaging, yet generating images that faithfully reflect meaningful patient characteristics remains challenging. In this work, we investigate metadata-conditioned cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) synthesis using a pretrained latent diffusion model, encoding structured clinical metadata and slice position as textual prompts to guide CMR generation. To improve metadata adherence and address the imbalance of clinical attributes, we integrate three strategies: Metadata-Free Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), Contrastive Batching, and Inverse-Frequency Sampling. The framework was fine-tuned and evaluated on 59,058 short-axis CMR from the UK Biobank using paired image similarity, distributional fidelity, and subgroup-level analyses. The combined approach achieved a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 37.47, improving by 57.04\% over the same model fine-tuned without these strategies and by 28.68\% over a previous text-conditioned CMR diffusion baseline requiring cardiac geometry as additional input, while relying solely on patient metadata. This distributional gain, driven mainly by Metadata-Free CFG, came with a modest reduction in paired similarity, suggesting that the model prioritizes population-level realism over exact image reproduction. Subgroup analyses demonstrated improved alignment across demographic and acquisition-related metadata, with disease-specific conditioning being the most challenging task. These findings demonstrate the potential of generative foundation models for clinically meaningful CMR synthesis while highlighting the need for more effective metadata-aware conditioning strategies. Our code is available at https://github.com/rodriguezmarc/conditional-cmr.

articles.title_zh: 改进有条件的遗留集束弹药基因基础模型 综述
articles.content_zh: 合成图像生成是解决数据稀缺和医学成像中临床上重要的酚类代表性不足问题的一个有希望的战略,然而,生成忠实反映患者有意义的特征的图像仍然具有挑战性. 在这项工作中,我们利用预先训练的潜在扩散模型,对结构化的临床元数据进行编码,并进行切片位置作为文字提示,对元数据条件化的心磁共振(CMR)合成进行研究,以指导CMR生成. 为提高元数据的坚持性,解决临床属性不平衡的问题,我们综合了三项战略: 元数据-无分类器-无指导(CFG),对比棒(Contrestive Batching),和逆向抽样. 对框架进行了微调和评价,利用联合王国生物库的59 058个短轴CMR进行了对映图像的相似性、分布忠诚度和分组分析。 综合方法实现了37.47的Fréchet Inception District(FID),比没有这些战略的同一模型的微调改进了57.04×××,比以前的文本条件的CMR扩散基线改进了28.68××,该基准要求心脏几何作为补充投入,同时完全依赖病人的元数据。 这种主要由元数据自由CFG驱动的分布增益随着对映相似性略微减少而来,表明模型将人口层面的现实主义优先于精确的图像复制. 分组分析表明,人口和购置相关元数据之间更加一致,具体疾病条件是最具有挑战性的任务。 这些研究结果表明基因基础模型在临床上有意义的CMR合成方面的潜力,同时强调需要更有效的元数据认识调节战略。 我们的代码见https://github.com/rodriguezmarc/enteral-cmr。

articles.title: Mind the Student: Behavioral and Contextual Cues for Automated Engagement Prediction in Online Learning
articles.content: The prediction of student engagement from the online tutoring videos is difficult because engagement is a multidimensional construct comprising distinct behavioral, emotional, and cognitive states. A reliable prediction requires bringing together different types of behavioral signals as well as expressive cues. Through our analysis of the CASED dataset, it is clear that engagement prediction gets even harder due to the high inter-person variability as well as the subjectivity of the engagement annotation. To tackle these challenges, we develop a multimodal framework that integrates the implicit spatiotemporal features extracted from pretrained video, audio, and image encoders along with structured behavioral modalities like head pose, gaze, facial action units, emotion, and wavelet-based audio features. We integrate these modalities via a Perceiver IO latent bottleneck. Moreover, student and instructor personalities are modeled as variational posteriors over learnable embeddings to enable partial pooling across participants. We employ evidential regression and spectral-normalized Gaussian process classification heads for uncertainty-aware prediction to further improve robustness and calibration. Benchmark on the CASED challenge test set shows that all participating methods converge near random-chance performance, revealing the difficulty of the dataset. In this highly ambiguous regime, our framework achieves competitive performance while uniquely offering well-calibrated uncertainty metrics, demonstrating that reliable risk-quantification is an essential prerequisite for deploying engagement models in real-world educational tools.

articles.title_zh: 注意学生:自动参与在线学习的行为和背景
articles.content_zh: 网络辅导视频对学生参与的预测是困难的,因为参与是一个多层面的构思,包含不同的行为、情感和认知状态。 可靠的预测需要将不同类型的行为信号以及表现提示集合起来. 通过我们对CASED数据集的分析,很明显,由于人与人之间的高度变化以及参与说明的主观性,参与预测变得更加困难。 为了应对这些挑战,我们开发了一个多式联运框架,其中结合了从预先训练的视频、音频和图像编码器中提取的隐含的瞬间特征,以及结构化的行为模式,如头部姿势、目光、面部动作单元、情感和波浪式音频特征。 我们通过潜在瓶颈整合这些模式。 此外,学生和教员人物被作为可学习嵌入物的变异后人,以便能够在参与者之间进行部分汇集。 我们使用证据回归和光谱常态高斯过程分类头来进行不确定性感知预测,以进一步提高稳健度和校准度. CASED挑战测试集的基准显示,所有参与方法都接近随机抽取性能,揭示了数据集的难度. 在这个非常模棱两可的制度中,我们的框架实现了竞争性业绩,同时提供了经过适当调整的不确定性指标,表明可靠的风险量化是将参与模式用于现实世界教育工具的必要先决条件。

articles.title: SeMoCo: A Semantic-First Motion Codec for Motion Language Modeling
articles.content: Discrete motion representations have substantially advanced autoregressive text-to-motion generation. However, most motion tokenizers are optimized for reconstruction and do not explicitly allocate capacity according to semantic role. Action-level meaning and fine-grained kinematic detail must therefore be encoded through the same reconstruction-driven hierarchy. We introduce SeMoCo, a semantic-first motion codec, together with a dual-axis motion generator for language-conditioned motion generation. Each motion token contains one semantic token and a residual sequence of kinematic tokens. The generator models semantic progression across time and autoregressively refines the residual entries. We also construct $Ω$-MotionVerse, a large-scale, multi-source human-motion dataset unified under the SOMA representation. Across the reported comparisons, SeMoCo achieves the best reconstruction accuracy among the compared codecs, while strong text-to-motion results demonstrate the effectiveness of its motion tokens for downstream generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SeMoCo: 用于运动语言模型的语义-第一运动代码
articles.content_zh: 分明的运动表达方式大大推进了自旋式文本对运动生成. 然而,大多数运动示意器被优化用于重建,没有按照语义角色明确分配能力. 因此,行动层面的含义和精细的动漫细节必须通过同样的重建驱动的等级来编码。 我们介绍SeMoCo,一种语义第一运动编码器,以及用于语言条件运动生成的双轴运动发生器. 每个运动符号都包含一个语义符号和一个运动符号的剩余序列. 生成器模型语义跨时间进化,并自动完善剩余条目. 我们还在SOMA代表系统下构建一个大规模、多源的人类运动数据集。 在整个报告的比较中,SeMoCo在比较的解码器中实现了最佳的重建精度,而强力的文字对运动结果则证明了其运动符号对下游一代的有效性.

articles.title: Keep-or-Drop? Adaptive Tokenizer for Compact Video Representation
articles.content: Latent diffusion models have emerged as a dominant framework for high-fidelity image and video synthesis, operating in compact latent spaces with variational autoencoders (VAEs) to enhance computational efficiency without compromising visual quality. However, conventional VAEs are suboptimal for video data as they employ fixed compression ratios that cannot adapt to the varying complexity of spatio-temporal content. We present KATok (Keep-or-Drop? Adaptive Tokenizer for Compact Video Representation), a transformer-based VAE that incorporates an adaptive token selector which is jointly learned with latent tokens. By evaluating each token's content-richness as keep-or-drop probability, the token selector effectively discards uninformative tokens, naturally allowing data-dependent compression. Applying adaptive tokenization to diffusion models may cause spatial misalignment, as token dropping can disturb the original spatio-temporal structure. To alleviate this issue, we propose two position-prediction strategies: cascaded and joint generation, to ensure spatial consistency. We empirically show that our model achieves strong reconstruction and generation quality at a state-of-the-art compression ratio. Further analysis on video data reveals that this improvement is primarily achieved by reducing spatio-temporal redundancy and removing uninformative tokens, as supported by both quantitative and qualitative results.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 继续还是继续? 缩略语视频显示器的可调性
articles.content_zh: Latet扩散模型已成为高真实度图像和视频合成的主导框架,在紧凑的潜在空间中运行,具有变异自编码器(VAEs),以提高计算效率而不损害视觉质量. 然而,传统的VAE对于视频数据来说是次优的,因为它们采用了固定的压缩比,无法适应时空内容的不同复杂性. 我们介绍KATOK(保持还是缩小?) 缩合视频显示器的可调适切除器,这是一种基于变压器的VAE,它包含一个适应性信号选择器,与潜在信号器共同学习。 通过将每个令牌的内容丰富度评价为保持-或滴入概率,令牌选择器有效地丢弃了非信息化的令牌,自然允许依赖数据的压缩. 将适应性标志化应用到扩散模型中可能会造成空间错位,因为信物下降会扰乱原始的时空结构. 为了缓解这一问题,我们提出了两个定位预测战略:级联和联合生成,以确保空间一致性。 我们的经验显示,我们的模型以最先进的压缩率,实现了强大的重建和发电质量. 对视频数据的进一步分析表明,这种改进主要是通过减少时空冗余和去除非信息信号来实现的,这得到了数量和质量结果的支持。

articles.title: CARE: Camera-Residual Reserves for First Sightings in Adaptive LiDAR Sensing
articles.content: Adaptive LiDAR scanning concentrates a limited sensing budget on regions of interest predicted from past object tracks, lowering data volume in autonomous driving while maintaining detection accuracy. However, existing scanning policies face three challenges. First, history-driven approaches depend on past tracks, so unseen objects are detected late or missed. Second, random or uniform sampling outside the predicted regions has no awareness of where new objects appear. Third, camera-guided alternatives spend budget on all camera detections, resampling objects already covered, costing recall in crowded scenes and range when budgets are scarce. This paper introduces the CAmera-REsidual reserve (CARE), a training-free allocation rule that reserves part of a fixed ray budget for the directions of current camera detections that the track forecasts cannot explain; the rest follows the base history policy, and unused reserve returns to a random floor. The paper makes three contributions. First, a leakage-free ray-budget evaluation on nuScenes (150 scenes, 4,148 events) measuring the first-sighting loss of history-driven scanning, with a strict-causal variant using the preceding keyframe. Second, CARE raises first-sighting recall by 5.2, 5.2, and 4.3 points at 10%, 20%, and 35% budgets over the history policy, with paired intervals excluding zero; the camera cue drives this gain, and the first-sighting versus overall trade-off is a budget-dependent Pareto choice. Third, a safety-bounded forgetting module that releases budget from receding or static tracks beyond a speed-dependent guard distance; at tight budgets, forgetting without the guard significantly harms near-field recall, so the guard is what keeps it safe. The pipeline runs end to end on a real vehicle and, in closed-loop simulation, detects an occluded pedestrian earlier and brakes more reliably than history-driven scanning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CARE: 适应性LiDAR中第一视觉的摄影机备用设备 遥感
articles.content_zh: 适应性LiDAR扫描将有限的感知预算集中在过去物体轨道预测感兴趣的地区,降低自主驱动的数据量,同时保持探测准确性. 然而,现有的扫描政策面临三个挑战。 首先,历史驱动的方法依赖于过去的轨迹,因此看不见的物体被检测到晚或错过. 第二,在预测区域之外进行随机或统一的取样,并不知道新物体在哪里出现。 第三,摄像头制导的替代品将预算用于所有摄像头的探测、对已经覆盖的物体进行重新取样、在拥挤的场景中计算召回费用以及在预算稀少时计算范围。 本文引入了Camera-Residual储备(CARE),这是免训练分配规则,将部分固定射线预算用于当前摄像头探测方向,赛道预测无法解释;其余部分遵循基底历史政策,未使用的储备返回随机层. 该文件作出了三项贡献。 首先,对nuScenes(150场,4,148场事件)进行无渗漏射线预算评价,测量历史驱动扫描的第一眼损失,采用前一个键框的严格因果变体. 第二,援外社以5.2、5.2和4.3的分数对历史政策提出了第一眼回顾,分别是10%、20%和35%的预算,配对间隔不包括0;镜头提示推动这一收益,而第一眼与总体权衡是预算依赖的帕雷托选择。 第三,一个安全带限制的忘却模块释放出超出依赖速度的守卫距离的退缩或静态轨道上的预算;在紧凑的预算中,没有守卫的忘却会给近地召回造成重大伤害,所以守备是保证它安全的原因. 输油管末端为真车辆,在闭路模拟中,提前检测到一个被吞噬的行人,刹车比历史驱动的扫描更可靠.

articles.title: Example-based Robust Abnormality Detection with Minimal Annotations using Exemplar Med-DETR
articles.content: Reducing annotation requirements remains a key challenge in developing robust medical object detectors. To address this, Vision-Language (VL) object detection methods leverage grounding text information to enable powerful zero-shot and few-shot object detectors in the natural image domain [1, 2, 3, 4]. However, transferring these methods to the medical domain is challenging due to the absence of comparable quality and quantity of the grounding data. Regardless, significant contextual and non-imaging information exists in medical images that remains underutilized. Few-shot learning (FSL) techniques partially address this limitation but struggle to general ize to unseen medical findings and require extensive retraining when new findings are introduced [5, 6]. To overcome these challenges, we extend our prior EM-DETR framework [7] and introduce a scalable FS detection approach designed for efficient abnormality detection in Chest X-Ray (CXR) images under minimal supervision. The proposed architecture incorporates exemplar-based feature generation and domain-aware contrastive optimization, enabling effective adaptation to novel disease findings without exhaustive retraining. Our method achieves near state-of-the-art (SOTA) detection performance using less than 10% of the annotated data, demonstrating its potential for practical, annotation-efficient clinical deployment across both proprietary and public CXR datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以实例为基础的强力异常检测和最小说明
articles.content_zh: 减少注释要求仍然是开发强有力的医疗物体探测器的关键挑战。 为了解决这个问题,Visual-Language(VL)对象检测方法利用地面文本信息,在自然图像域启用强大的零射和数射对象检测器[1,2,3,4]. 然而,由于地面数据的质量和数量没有可比性,将这些方法转移到医疗领域具有挑战性。 无论如何,在医疗图像中存在重要的背景和非成像信息,而这些信息仍然没有得到充分利用。 很少的速成学习技术部分地解决了这一局限性,但努力将医学发现普遍化为看不见的,并在采用新的发现时需要进行广泛的再培训[5、6]。 为了克服这些挑战,我们扩展了我们先前的EM-DETR框架[7],并采用了一种可伸缩的FS检测方法,以便在最低限度的监督下在胸X射线(CXR)图像中高效的异常检测. 拟议架构包括以实例为基础的特征生成和域意识对比优化,从而能够有效适应新的疾病发现,而无需进行详尽的再培训。 我们的方法利用不到10%的注释数据,实现了近乎最先进的(SOTA)检测性能,表明它在专利和公共CXR数据集中具有实用、注解高效临床部署的潜力。

articles.title: Real-World Knowledge-Guided Change Data Synthesis for Remote Sensing
articles.content: Change data synthesis provides a cost-effective solution for expanding training data and improving the performance of change detection models. However, existing synthesis methods typically rely on handcrafted rules to simulate changes, where limited coverage of class transitions restricts the diversity of synthesized data, while predefined transition designs limit their flexibility in accommodating varied change types. In this work, we introduce KnowChange, a knowledge-guided change data synthesis framework that leverages pretrained vision-language models as knowledge sources to reason about plausible change locations and class transitions from pre-change scenes and desired change types. By integrating knowledge-guided change simulation with generalizable synthesis models, KnowChange enables flexible synthesis of diverse change types within a unified framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KnowChange-generated data consistently outperforms existing synthetic datasets in both synthetic-to-real transfer and synthetic data augmentation, despite being generated at a compact scale. Further analyses show that the knowledge-guided change simulation can be seamlessly integrated into existing synthesis pipelines and enhance the downstream utility of synthesized data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 现实世界知识指南 遥感数据合成变化
articles.content_zh: 变化数据综合为扩展培训数据并改进变化检测模型的性能提供了一个成本效益高的解决办法. 然而,现有的合成方法通常依靠手工制作的规则来模拟变化,即类过渡的有限覆盖面限制了被合成数据的多样性,而预先定义的过渡设计则限制了它们适应不同变化类型的灵活性. 在这项工作中,我们引入了"知识变化"(KnowChange),这是一个由知识指导的变革数据合成框架,它利用预先训练过的视觉语言模型作为知识来源,来解释从变革前场景和所期望的变革类型中可能发生的变革位置和阶级转变. KnowChange通过将知识引导的变化模拟与通俗化的合成模型相结合,使得在统一的框架内灵活地合成各种变化类型。 广泛的实验表明,KnowChange所生成的数据在合成到实际转移和合成数据增强方面,尽管是以紧凑的规模生成的,但始终比现有的合成数据集强。 进一步的分析表明,知识引导的变化模拟可以无缝地融入现有的合成管道,并增强合成数据的下游效用.

articles.title: Event-Based Motion Estimation via Oriented Distance Fields
articles.content: Event-based motion estimation is central to tasks that demand high temporal resolution and robustness to fast motion. Existing methods typically rely on iterative optimization or repeated hypothesis comparison, offsetting the sensor's low-latency advantage. We propose Oriented Distance Field Motion Estimation (ODF Motion Estimation), which replaces this optimization with a single averaging step over a precomputed field of event distance vectors, combined with an adaptive event-count selection strategy and a parameter-free trail filter. On public and self-collected datasets, ODF motion estimation reaches sub-pixel accuracy at the lowest latency among compared methods. We validate its generality on two downstream applications rather than treating them as separate contributions. First, the estimated trajectory is converted into a blur kernel and paired with a compact iterative-unfolding network, trained on simulated motion-estimation noise, for real-time non-blind image deblurring, attaining competitive or superior PSNR/SSIM with under 1M parameters. Second, the same precomputed field is repurposed for directional event filtering in a low-power asynchronous pupil and glint tracker, sustaining stable tracking for tens of seconds while lowering a near-eye module's power draw.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过定向远程场对基于事件的动议进行估计
articles.content_zh: 基于事件的运动估计对于需要高时间分辨率和快速运动的强健性的任务至关重要。 现有方法一般依靠迭代优化或重复假说比较,抵消了传感器的低纬度优势. 我们提出"定向距离场运动估计"(ODF Motion Estitution),取而代之的是这一优化,取而代之的是单个平均步骤,取而代之的是预计算出的事件距离向量领域,并结合了适应性事件计数选择策略和无参数线索过滤. 在公共和自行收集的数据集上,ODF运动估计以比较方法中最低的空闲时间达到子像素精度. 我们确认它对于两个下游应用的笼统性,而不是把它们当作单独的贡献。 首先,估计轨迹被转换为模糊的内核并配以紧凑的迭代-叠接网络,通过模拟运动-估计噪声进行训练,用于实时的非盲图像分解,达到具有竞争力或优异的PSNR/SSIM,参数低于1M. 第二,相同的预计算场被重新用于在低功率的相同步瞳孔和克林特跟踪器中进行定向事件过滤,在降低近视舱的功率平分的同时保持了数十秒的稳定跟踪.

articles.title: Beauty is in the ELBO of the Beholder: A Variational Account of Processing Fluency in Face Perception
articles.content: Facial attractiveness has been linked to statistical regularities such as symmetry and averageness, suggesting that beauty may depend on the ease with which a face is perceived. We empirically test this hypothesis by training variational autoencoders on four face datasets without attractiveness supervision and evaluating their representations on the 597 faces from the Chicago Face Database. Across models, human attractiveness ratings closely aligns with the direction defined by the VAE evidence lower bound (ELBO) in rate-distortion space. Independently learned latent spaces contain an attractiveness direction that transfers strongly across random initializations and training data. We also find that attractive faces are more prototypical in both shape and latent space. Our results connect classic accounts of aesthetics with learned generative models and provide empirical support for a variational interpretation of the processing fluency theory of aesthetic pleasure.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 美在目视者的ELBO中: 处理流利在面相感中的变相账户
articles.content_zh: 相貌的吸引力一直与统计规律相联,如对称和平均等,表明美貌可能取决于对相貌的感知是否容易. 我们通过在4个面相数据集上培训变异自编码器来经验性地测试这个假说,而不进行吸引力监督,并评估其在芝加哥面相数据库597个面相上的表示. 在整个模型中,人类的吸引力评级与VAE证据下限(ELBO)在速率扭曲空间所定义的方向紧密一致. 独立学习的潜在空间包含一个吸引力方向,在随机初始化和培训数据之间大力转移。 我们还发现,有吸引力的面孔在外形和潜在空间方面都比较典型。 我们的成果将美学的经典叙述与所学的基因模型相连接,并为对审美快感的处理流性理论的可变解释提供经验性支持.

articles.title: NeoWorld-Pro: Programming Interactive Scenes from Monocular Images for Embodied Simulation
articles.content: The advancement of Embodied AI necessitates high-quality simulation assets that faithfully mirror the real world. However, transforming raw visual observations into simulation-ready scenes remains challenging due to the lack of physical grounding and scene-level interactivity in current image-to-URDF methods. We propose NeoWorld-Pro, a framework that reformulates monocular scene reconstruction as procedural programming for interactive 3D environments. Leveraging the zero-shot reasoning and code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs, NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into executable programs specifying object geometry, articulation, and physical properties. A physics-in-the-loop mechanism then iteratively refines the generated programs by validating their execution in a physics engine, enforcing physically plausible articulations, valid object compositions and interactions, and accurate spatial relationships. Experiments show that NeoWorld-Pro outperforms open-loop and prior monocular reconstruction methods, while enabling complex downstream tasks such as stable stacking and fine-grained manipulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: NeoWorld-Pro: 从单相机图像中编程互动场景用于健美模拟
articles.content_zh: 健全AI的进步要求高质量的模拟资产忠实地反映现实世界. 然而,将原始的视觉观测转化为模拟准备场景仍然具有挑战性,因为目前图像与URDF方法缺乏物理地基和场景层面的相互作用. 我们提议NeoWorld-Pro,这个框架将单相机场景重建重新设定为交互式3D环境的程序编程. 利用MLLMs的零射出推理和代码合成能力,NeoWorld-Pro将一个单一的RGB图像转换为可执行程序来指定对象几何,表达,和物理属性. 然后通过在物理引擎中验证其执行,执行物理上可信的表达,有效的物体组成和相互作用,以及准确的空间关系,从而对生成的程序进行迭代完善。 实验显示,NeoWorld-Pro的性能优于开放-loop和之前的单体重建方法,同时能够实现稳定的堆放和精细的操纵等复杂的下游任务.

articles.title: Amortized Set Prediction for Inverse IFS Reconstruction from Density Maps
articles.content: Iterated Function Systems (IFS) generate self-similar fractals from a few contractive affine maps. The forward map from parameters to images is computationally inexpensive and well understood, whereas the inverse problem of estimating maps from an image is difficult and is typically handled by per-image optimization. We replace this loop with a single forward pass of a learned estimator that predicts the affine-map set directly from a visit-frequency density map, thereby amortizing the inverse problem. The design follows two constraints. First, density maps do not uniquely identify IFS parameters, so evaluation is based on reconstruction rather than parameter recovery; unordered map sets are handled by Hungarian matching, and ground-truth parameters provide a stable training surrogate. Second, the fully known forward model lets us generate exact synthetic training pairs and also supports image-only test-time refinement. On in-distribution tests, amortized initialization plus a few refinement steps lies on a better quality--speed frontier than equal-budget random-initialized per-image optimization, and a 30-step refinement (about $0.56$ s per sample) remains better than a doubled-budget baseline. Extending optimization to 1000 steps shows that the benefit is not only speed: amortized initialization reaches high-quality reconstructions more frequently than random starts. On real images (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST), it improves density metrics on average over a published per-image optimizer while being roughly 12 to 2600 times faster.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 根据密度图进行反向IFS重建的预估
articles.content_zh: 迭接函数系统(IFS)从几个相接的相接图中生成自相仿的分形. 从参数到图像的先行图在计算上成本低廉,而且人们也非常了解,而从图像中估计地图的反向问题则很困难,通常由每个图像的优化处理。 我们用一个有学识的估算器的单个前行通道来取代这个循环,该图像直接从访问频率密度图中预测出相近相图,从而分解反向问题。 设计遵循两个制约因素. 首先,密度图不独有地识别IFS参数,因此评价是基于重建,而不是参数恢复;未排序的地图集由匈牙利匹配处理,地真参数提供稳定的训练代用. 第二,完全已知的前进模型让我们产生精确的合成训练对并也支持只用图像的测试时间的改进. 在分配中测试方面,分期摊还初始化加上一些改进步骤,取决于比同等预算的随机初始化人造图像优化更好的质量快的前沿,30步骤的改进(每个样本约0.56美元)仍然比双倍预算基线好。 将优化范围扩大到1000个步骤表明,好处不仅是速度:分期初始化比随机启动更频繁地达到高质量的重建. 在真实的图像(MNIST和Fashion-MNIST)上,它平均比公布的每个图像优化器提高密度度量,同时速度大约为12到2600倍.

articles.title: SandwichQuant: Which Parameters Matter Before and After Quantization?
articles.content: Quantization correction methods usually optimize weights, quantization parameters, or reconstruction objectives, while the underlying parameter subspaces responsible for effective correction remain unclear. In this work, we study quantization correction from a parameter subspace perspective and reveal that correction capability is highly non-uniform across parameter groups. By decomposing trainable parameters into backbone weights, normalization-affine parameters, and quantization parameters, we show that the low-dimensional normalization-affine subspace provides a highly efficient correction direction under matched budgets. Based on this finding, we propose SandwichQuant, a two-stage normalization-affine correction framework that performs adaptation before and after quantization. The pre-stage improves quantization robustness, while the post-stage compensates residual errors after the quantized graph is fixed. Extensive experiments on vision models and large language models demonstrate consistent improvements under various low-bit quantization settings, validating the effectiveness of subspace-aligned correction.

articles.title_zh: 桑威奇量子:哪些参数在量子化前后都很重要?.
articles.content_zh: 定量校正方法通常能优化权重,定量参数,或重建目标,而负责有效校正的基本参数子空间仍不明确. 在这项工作中,我们从参数子空间的角度研究定量校正,并揭示校正能力在参数组中高度不统一. 通过将可训练参数分解为主干重,常态-美因参数,以及量化参数,我们显示低维常态-美因子空间在相匹配的预算中提供了高效的校正方向. 基于这一调查结果,我们提议建立 " 桑威奇量 " 方案,这是在量化前后进行调整的两级正常化-美工校正框架。 前期改进了量化稳健性,而后期补偿了被量化的图被固定后所留下的误差. 对视觉模型和大语言模型的广泛实验表明,在各种低位量化设置下,不断改进,验证了子空间相通校正的有效性.

articles.title: ViSculpt: Visual-Centric Agentic Geometry Editing
articles.content: 3D geometry editing is a critical yet labor-intensive part of the graphics pipeline, requiring artists to translate creative intent into precise operations in complex professional software. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for script-based 3D creation, but script generation is less suited to perception-driven editing of arbitrary existing meshes, where execution must remain visually grounded and untouched regions should be preserved. We present a \emph{visual-centric}, training-free multi-agent system that edits existing 3D meshes directly in Blender by emulating the iterative workflow of human artists. Rather than generating scripts or regenerating geometry, our system operates through the Blender GUI: multimodal LLM agents observe the viewport, reason about the current mesh state, and execute localized edits through simulated user interactions. Experiments on a curated benchmark provide initial evidence that this agentic approach can follow natural language instructions, perform representative localized mesh edits, and preserve the overall identity of the input asset. Our results highlight a complementary regime for language-driven 3D editing: direct in-place modification of existing meshes within the native 3D editing workflow. We view this work as an exploratory step toward visual-centric agentic geometry editing in professional graphics software.

articles.title_zh: 活体雕塑:视觉-Centric 代理几何编辑
articles.content_zh: 3D几何编辑是图形管道中关键而劳动密集型的部分,需要艺术家将创作意向转化为复杂的专业软件中的精确操作. 大型语言模型(LLMs)对基于脚本的3D创建表现出了希望,但脚本生成不太适合被感官所驱动的对任意现存的 meshes的编辑,其中执行必须保持视网膜站住脚,并应当保留未被触及的区域. 我们呈现一个\emph{以视觉为中心的}免费训练的多代理系统,通过模仿人类艺术家的迭接工作流程,直接编辑Blender中现有的3D meshes. 我们的系统不是生成脚本或再生成几何图形,而是通过Blender GUI运行:多模式 LLM代理观察取景口,当前网格状态的理由,并通过模拟用户互动执行本地化编辑. 对被整理基准的实验提供了初步证据,证明这种代理方法可以遵循自然语言指令,进行具有代表性的局部网格编辑,并保持输入资产的整体特征. 我们的成果突出了一种由语言驱动的3D编辑的互补制度:在本地3D编辑工作流程中直接对已存在的元件进行就地修改。 我们认为这项工作是朝着专业图形软件中以视觉为中心进行几何编辑的探索性步骤。

articles.title: Decoupling candidate dual AGN from chance superpositions in the GOTHIC survey via a deep-learning framework
articles.content: Dual active galactic nuclei (DAGN) mark a critical phase in the evolution of merging galaxies and the pairing of supermassive black holes, yet they remain difficult to identify in large imaging surveys because of projection effects and limited spatial resolution. Compact foreground stars and unresolved substructure can mimic dual nuclei through chance superposition, complicating automated detection. We revisit the 46,061 galaxies flagged but rejected as DAGN candidates by the GOTHIC pipeline, primarily because the two nuclei fell within the SDSS fibre aperture or exceeded its separation threshold. We train a supervised deep-learning framework based on the YOLOv11 oriented-bounding-box architecture on annotated SDSS imaging to separate genuine dual nuclei from foreground stellar contaminants and other spurious alignments. The final model attains a validation precision of 0.919, recall of 0.905, and $F_1$ of 0.912 for the dual-nuclei class, and yields 29,605 dual-nucleus candidates after removing star-dominated and blended detections. Structured visual inspection indicates that $54.5$--$62\%$ are consistent with genuine dual nuclei, implying $\sim(1.4$--$1.8)\times10^{4}$ plausible systems. Cross-calibrating the YOLO separation against the deterministic GOTHIC centroid measurement and restricting to the compact regime ($d \le 6.87''$) gives a conservative subset of $\sim 13{,}672$ candidates, reaching calibrated separations of $\sim 0.56''$. Spectroscopy of the most compact ($\le 1$~kpc) systems shows they are dominated by passive, absorption-line galaxies with no resolved double-peaked emission, so confirmation requires higher-resolution follow-up. The catalogue is a statistically refined list of candidates, not confirmed DAGN. Nonetheless, deep-learning detection substantially reduces contamination and expands the plausible DAGN census.

articles.title_zh: 通过一个深入学习的框架,将候选人双重AGN与GOTHIC调查中的机会叠加脱钩
articles.content_zh: 双活性银河核(DAGN)标志着星系融合演化和超大质量黑洞对接的关键阶段,然而由于投影效果和空间分辨率有限,它们在大成像测量中仍然难以识别. 压缩前地恒星和未解决的子结构可以通过机会叠加来模仿双核,使自动探测变得复杂. 我们重新审视被GOTHIC管道标出但作为DAGN候选物而被拒绝的46,061个星系,这主要是因为这两个核子落入了SDSS纤维孔径或超过了其分离阈值. 我们在附加说明的SSDS成像上,根据YOLOv11导向的框式架构,培训一个有监督的深层学习框架,将真正的双核与前地星状污染物和其他虚假对接区分开来。 最终型号的验证精度为0.919分,回溯为0.905分,双核级为0.912分的F_1分,去除以恒星为主并混合检测后,得分为29,605分. 结构化的目视检查表明,54.5-62美元与真正的双重核相符合,这意味着$\sim (1.4-1.8-times 10==4)美元是可信的系统。 将YOLO分离与确定性的GOTHIC百分数测量相交叉校正,并限制紧凑制度(d\le 6.87''$)给一个保守子集13{,}672美元候选人,达到0.56'$的校正分离. 对最紧凑的系统($\le 1$~kpc)的光谱学显示,它们以被动,吸收线的星系为主,没有解析出双峰排放,所以确认需要高分辨率的跟踪. 该目录是经过统计完善的候选人名单,未经确认的DAGN. 尽管如此,深入学习的探测能大大减少污染并扩展可行的DAGN普查。

articles.title: Rethinking Pre-Training and Augmentation for Zero-Shot Cross-City Object Detection
articles.content: Real-world deployment of traffic surveillance systems is bottlenecked by geographic domain shift, in which models trained in one city underperform when applied to an unseen target city. Conventional domain adaptation relies on hyperparameter-sensitive architectures or direct profiling of target data. Both are fundamentally precluded in privacy-conscious ecosystems that require completely blind training and evaluation loops. In this setting, we explore the effects of pre-training and augmentation in addressing the domain shift problem. Specifically, we propose a new modular training pipeline for object detection structured around two core orthogonal pillars: (1) a multi-dataset pre-training strategy featuring a class-agnostic objectness distillation to decouple structural vehicle geometry from semantic taxonomies, and (2) a domain-resilient augmentation stream featuring a novel Grayworld transformation that forces global attention heads to strip volatile chromatic shortcuts in favor of robust shape priors. When evaluated with the real-time transformer-based detector RF-DETR, our framework bridges cross-city distribution gaps while using limited GPU memory (16GB). Our optimized variants, RF-DETR-HR and RF-DETR-Grayworld, deliver a substantial empirical gain of +24.29 over the baseline, achieving 1st place (47.53 mAP) on the AI City Challenge Track 6 leaderboard. Code and data are available at: \href{https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city}{SKKUAutoLab/aic26\_cross\_city}.

articles.title_zh: 重新思考零相控跨城天体探测的预训和增强
articles.content_zh: 交通监测系统的实际部署受到地理域变化的瓶颈,在地理域变化中,在一个城市培训的模型在应用到一个看不见的目标城市时表现不佳。 常规域适应依赖于超参数敏感架构或目标数据的直接剖面. 在需要完全盲目培训和评估循环的自觉生态系统中,两者都受到根本的排斥。 在此背景下,我们探索预训和扩能对解决域位转移问题的影响. 具体地说,我们提议建立一个新的模块化的物体检测培训管道,其结构围绕两个核心正交支柱:(1) 一种多数据集的预培训战略,其特点是阶级不可知的物体分馏,使结构载体几何学与语义分类学脱钩;和(2) 一种域能抗振增强流,其特点是一种新型的灰地世界变换,使全球注意力头向起去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去去 在使用实时变压器的探测器RF-DETR进行评价时,我们的框架在使用有限的GPU内存(16GB)的同时会架设跨城市分布缺口. 我们的优化变体 -- -- RF-DETR-HR和RF-DETR-Grayworld -- -- 使+24.29的实证收益超过基线,在AI城市挑战轨道6领导板上取得了第1名(47.53 mAP)。 代码和数据见:\href{ https://github.com/SKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city_SKUAutoLab/aic26_cross_city}(中文(简体) ).

articles.title: What Does Prompt Learning Change? -A Natural-Language Concept Analysis of Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Prompt learning adapts vision-language models such as CLIP by optimizing continuous prompt vectors, but the learned prompts are difficult to interpret in natural language. We present PromptSpLiCE, a post-hoc method that expresses each class-conditioned text embedding as a sparse combination of concepts from a fixed natural-language dictionary. Using the same dictionary before and after prompt learning allows us to compare changes in their concept profiles. We evaluate PromptSpLiCE on CoOp, a representative prompt-learning method, across 11 image-classification datasets. The concept profiles change substantially: on average, only 1.6 of the initial top-10 concepts remain in the top 10 after learning. Across datasets, profile change is positively associated with accuracy gain. We also derive a local gradient expression that provides geometric intuition for why image-aligned concept directions distinct from the current prompt can have greater loss sensitivity.

articles.title_zh: 快速学习有什么变化? - 视觉语言模型的自然语言概念分析
articles.content_zh: 即时学习通过优化连续即时向量来适应CLIP等视觉语言模型,但所学的即时功能很难用自然语言来解释. 我们提出 ExpressSpLICE ,一种后热法,表达每个类条件文本嵌入,作为固定自然语言词典中概念的稀有组合. 在即时学习前后使用同名词典,使我们能够比较他们概念配置的变化. 我们评价CoOp上的ExpressSpLICE,这是一种有代表性的即时学习方法,跨越了11个图像分类数据集. 概念简介发生了很大变化:平均而言,在最初的前10个概念中,只有1.6个在学习后仍留在前10个概念中。 在整个数据集中,剖面变化与精度增益有着正相关. 我们还得出一个局部梯度表达式,提供几何直觉,说明为什么不同于当前快感的图像相通概念方向可以具有更大的损失敏感性.

articles.title: Rubrics as Visual-Repair Context for Self-Evolving UI-to-Code Generation
articles.content: Large vision-language models have shown strong progress in UI-to-code generation, yet their test-time self-evolution remains unstable. We first identify a fundamental obstacle, termed visual repair coupling: a local code edit may propagate through layout, style, and component dependencies, correcting one visual mismatch while degrading regions that were previously faithful. To address this issue, we present RubSE, a Rubric-guided Self-Evolution framework that uses rubrics to represent visual feedback as a structured visual-repair context. At each refinement round, RubSE generates typed candidate rubrics, selects one prioritized repair target, and stores previously selected rubrics as history, thereby steering each revision toward a well-scoped visual repair while discouraging repeated or over-broad changes. Evaluations across six VLMs and three UI-to-code benchmarks demonstrate that RubSE substantially outperforms naïve self-evolution in final-round and best-round settings, achieving more stable refinement trajectories and a higher trajectory-level performance ceiling. Further analysis shows that RubSE mitigates trajectory collapse by improving recovery from severe visual regressions, and that stronger rubric generators can transfer effective visual-repair guidance to weaker code improvers.

articles.title_zh: Rubrics 作为自演化的UI到代码生成的可视-Repair背景
articles.content_zh: 大型的视觉语言模型在UI到代码生成中显示出了强劲的进步,然而他们的测试时间自演仍然不稳定. 我们首先找出一个基本障碍,称为视觉修补耦合:本地代码编辑可能通过布局、风格和组件依赖性来传播,纠正一个视觉不匹配,同时贬低以前忠实的地区。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出RubSE,一个由Rubric制导的自演框架,它使用标题来代表视觉反馈作为结构化的视觉-修复背景. 在每次改进回合,RubSE都会生成打入的候选面额,选择一个优先的修复目标,并将之前选择的面额存储为历史,从而将每次修改都引导到一个范围清晰的视觉修复,同时劝阻重复或超宽的修改. 6个甚高频和3个UI到码基准的评价表明,RubSE在最后回合和最佳回合环境中大大超越了天真自演,实现了更稳定的完善轨迹和更高的轨迹水平性能上限。 进一步的分析表明,RubSE通过改善从严重的视觉回归中恢复来缓解轨道崩溃,而更强的路由发电机可以将有效的视觉修复引导转移到更弱的代码改进器上.

articles.title: EgoErrorVQA: Assess Egocentric Comprehension Capabilities through Procedural Errors for Ego-Agentic AI
articles.content: The majority of our everyday activities are procedural and consist of sequences of interdependent steps. However, existing benchmarks for Visual Agents and Visual Language Models (VLMs) overlook the evaluation of their procedural comprehension ability from an egocentric visual perspective, particularly for detecting procedural errors, a critical capability for everyday assistance. To bridge this gap, the EgoErrorVQA task is firstly proposed for egocentric procedural comprehension with explicit procedural errors modeling. Besides, we develop a user-friendly evaluator agent based on the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, enabling rigorous and standardized evaluation of visual agents through VQA-based interaction. A range of models are evaluated using both open-ended and multiple-choice questions, revealing persistent weaknesses in handling procedural errors and error types. Moreover, we introduce Ego-ADR, an Adaptive Decoupled Reasoning framework that decouples complex procedural reasoning to enhance models' understanding of procedural errors. It achieves consistent performance gains over the selected baselines and attains state-of-the-art results on several metrics under comparable settings. Code: https://github.com/z1oong/EgoErrorVQA
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EgoErrorVQA:通过程序错误评估Ego-Agentic AI的EgoCentre综合能力
articles.content_zh: 我们的日常活动大多是程序性的,包括一系列相互依存的步骤。 然而,视觉代理人和视觉语言模型的现有基准忽略了从自我为中心的视觉角度对其程序理解能力的评价,特别是用于发现程序错误这一日常援助的关键能力。 为了弥补这一差距,EgoErrorVQA任务首先被提出来以自我为中心的程序理解,同时建立明确的程序错误模型。 此外,我们开发了基于Agent2Agent(A2A)协议的方便用户的评价剂,通过基于VQA的互动,能够对视觉剂进行严格而标准化的评价. 利用开放式和多选择问题评价了一系列模型,揭示了在处理程序错误和错误类型方面持续存在的弱点。 此外,我们介绍了Ego-ADR,这是一个适应性的脱钩理性框架,它与复杂的程序推理脱钩,以加强模型对程序错误的理解。 它在选定的基线上取得一致的业绩收益,并在可比环境下在若干衡量标准上取得最新成果。 代码:https://github.com/z1oong/EgoErrorVQA

articles.title: PlaceSeek: Human-Centered Geospatial Retrieval of Urban Outdoor Places via Semantic Grounding and Affective Alignment
articles.content: People search for urban outdoor places not only by category or function, but also by what activities a place can support and how it is perceived. Existing geospatial retrieval remains largely POIcentric and metadata-driven, making it difficult to satisfy openended, affective, or activity-oriented needs. We present PlaceSeek, a human-centered outdoor place retrieval framework that maps natural-language queries to geolocated street-view imagery. PlaceSeek introduces an intent-aware retrieval mechanism that decomposes user queries into functional and affective sub-intents. A Semantic Grounding Module verifies whether candidate street-view results contain the physical evidence needed to support the intended activity, while an Affective Alignment Module re-ranks physically valid candidates using a LoRA-adapted vision-language model trained on human urban perception judgments. We evaluate PlaceSeek on 31,956 street-view locations in Milan across 10 naturallanguage queries annotated by five human evaluators. PlaceSeek achieves 88.0% Precision@5, a mean match score of 3.39/4.0, and 0.920 nDCG@5, outperforming CLIP, fine-tuned CLIP, SigLIP, and a VQA-based baseline. Ablation results show that physical grounding is essential for retrieval validity, while affective alignment improves ranking quality among physically valid candidates. These findings highlight that complex urban spatial queries require modeling both verifiable visual evidence and human perceptual preferences. PlaceSeek provides a potential framework for human-centered nextgeneration geospatial retrieval systems.

articles.title_zh: PlaceSeek:通过语义地平地和情感对接方式对城市户外地点进行以人为本的地理空间检索
articles.content_zh: 人们不仅按类别或功能寻找城市户外场所,而且根据一个地方可以支持哪些活动以及如何看待。 现有的地理空间检索在很大程度上仍然是以PoI为中心、由元数据驱动的,因此难以满足开放式、有影响或面向活动的需求。 我们介绍PlaceSeek,这是一个以人为中心的户外地点检索框架,将自然语言的查询映射到地理定位的街景图象上。 PlaceSeek引入了一种意向意识检索机制,将用户查询分解为功能和有影响子提示. 一个语义定位模块核查候选街景结果是否包含支持预定活动所需的物证,而一个动感对接模块则使用经过人类城市感知判断培训的LORA适应视觉语言模型,对身体有效的候选人进行重新排序。 我们评价PlaceSeek在米兰的31,956个街景地点, PlaceSeek 实现 88.0%的精度@5,平均比分为3.39/4.0;0.920 nDCG@5,成绩优于CLIP,微调CLIP,SigLIP,以及基于VQA的基线. 校正结果表明,实体地基对检索有效性至关重要,而体能校正则提高实体有效候选人的排名质量。 这些研究结果突出表明,复杂的城市空间查询需要既建立可核查的视觉证据模型,又需要人的认知偏好。 PlaceSeek为以人为中心的下一代地理空间检索系统提供了潜在的框架.

articles.title: Syn2RealTrack: Bridging the Gap Between Synthetic and Real-World Datasets for Online Multi-View Multi-Target Tracking
articles.content: Multi-camera 3D perception systems for warehouse scenes are trained largely on synthetic data and evaluated on physically captured environments. The resulting synthetic-to-real gap, which corrupts ground-plane localization and cross-camera identity association, is usually treated as one deficiency for a single domain-adaptation module to absorb; we argue instead that it enters the pipeline at three separable points: the camera calibration, the object shape prior, and the assumption that the object census is known, each admitting a different local remedy. Our online pipeline, Syn2RealTrack, follows this decomposition: lens distortion is recovered from images alone under a calibration that provides none, detections are fused across views by a visibility-weighted part-based descriptor that abstains on occluded parts rather than guessing, person height is measured in closed form from calibration instead of copied from a synthetic prior, and a closed-world cardinality prior is paired with a causal filter that removes the phantom boxes the prior manufactures. The system therefore adapts by reallocating trust between geometry and appearance without retraining a feature extractor. On the AI City Challenge 2026 Track~1 evaluation server it reaches a 3D Higher Order Tracking Accuracy (HOTA) of 52.0118%. The code will be released at https://github.com/SKKUAutoLab/aic26_mc3dp

articles.title_zh: Syn2Real Track:为在线多维多目标跟踪缩小合成和真实世界数据集之间的差距
articles.content_zh: 仓库场景的多相机3D感知系统主要接受合成数据培训并接受物理捕获环境评估。 由此而来合成到真实的缺口会腐蚀地上飞机本地化和跨相机身份联系,通常会被当作一个单一域适应模块吸收的一个缺陷;我们争论说,它进入管道时有三个可分离点:相机校正,对象形状之前,以及对象普查已知的假设,每个都承认不同的局部补救. 我们的在线管道Syn2Real Track遵循这种分解方式:镜头扭曲是在不提供任何内容的校正下单独从图像中恢复的,探测器通过一个能见度加权的半成品描述器连接到视图中,该描述器对被吞噬的部分弃置而非猜测,人高从校正中以闭合形式衡量,而不是从合成前作复制而来,而闭合后的世界初品前作配有因果过滤器来去除前作的幻相盒. 因此,该系统通过重新分配几何学和外观之间的信任来适应,而无需再培训特征提取器. 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track~1评价服务器上,它达到了3D高序跟踪精确度(HOTA) 52.0118%. 该代码将在https://github.com/SKUAutoLab/aic26_mc3dp上发布.

articles.title: Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment for Radiology Report Generation with Large Language Models
articles.content: Radiology report generation (RRG) has recently benefited from large language models, which substantially improve report fluency. However, clinically faithful generation remains challenging because current supervision is still imposed mostly at the report level. This creates a granularity mismatch: radiology reports are composed of disease-grounded findings, while existing methods are trained mainly with whole-report objectives. To address this problem, we propose Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment, which reformulates image-report supervision as a hierarchical clinical alignment problem. Our method structures this alignment as a disease-conditioned process, where supervision is decomposed into two levels: Disease-Centric Alignment for fine-grained disease-specific correspondence, and Global Clinical Semantic Alignment for report-level semantic coherence. A clinical knowledge graph is used as a training-time-only structural prior that defines disease-specific supervision units and their clinical relationships, introducing no additional overhead at inference. Because standard contrastive alignment could produce false negatives when studies share overlapping pathologies, we combine instance-conditioned discriminative matching with disease-conditioned soft regularization, enabling fine-grained yet clinically consistent cross-modal representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, IU-Xray, and COV-CTR show that our method consistently improves performance on both conventional and clinical metrics. Notably, our 3B model surpasses several prior systems with larger 7B/13B backbones, suggesting that improving supervision structure, rather than increasing model size, can be more effective for RRG.

articles.title_zh: 图监督 放射学报告与大语言模型的分级临床对接
articles.content_zh: 放射科报告生成最近得益于大型语言模型,大大改善了报告的流畅度。 然而,在临床上忠于职守的一代仍然具有挑战性,因为目前的监督仍然主要在报告一级。 这就造成了颗粒性不匹配:放射学报告由基于疾病的研究结果组成,而现有的方法则主要以全报告的目标来培训. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出图监督的分级临床对接,将图像报告监督重新定为分级临床对接问题。 我们的方法将这种调整结构作为一个有疾病条件的过程,监督分解为两个层次: 疾病 -- -- 疾病 -- -- 疾病 -- -- 对应精细的疾病,以及全球临床语义 -- -- 报告层面语义一致性。 临床知识图被作为培训时间仅限结构的先行图,它定义了特定疾病监督单位及其临床关系,不引入额外的间接推断. 因为标准对比性对接在研究共享重叠病理时会产生假阴性,所以我们结合了以实例为条件的区别性对接与以疾病为条件的软正态对接,使得精细但临床上一致的跨模式表述成为可能. 关于MIMIC-CXR、IU-Xray和COV-CTR的实验表明,我们的方法不断提高常规和临床指标的性能。 值得注意的是,我们的3B模型超越了先前的几个系统,拥有更大的7B/13B骨干,这表明改进监督结构,而不是扩大模型规模,可以对RRG更加有效.

articles.title: TransPhy: Visual In-Context Learning for Physically Grounded Image Editing
articles.content: Visual demonstrations provide a natural interface for specifying image transformations that are difficult to describe exhaustively with text. However, existing visual in-context learning (VICL) methods primarily focus on appearance-level relation transfer and provide limited support for physically grounded transformations, whose outcomes depend on material properties, geometry, object interactions, and environmental conditions. Given a source--target exemplar pair and a query image, physically grounded VICL requires a model to infer the demonstrated transformation, adapt its effects to the query-specific scene context, and preserve rule-irrelevant content. We introduce PhysVICL-74, comprising 74 physically grounded transformation rules and 5,240 source--target image pairs that form nearly 75K training and evaluation contexts. Its benchmark split separately evaluates novel-instance transfer and unseen-rule generalization. We further propose TransPhy, a framework that decomposes physically grounded VICL into physical-rule induction and transition-aligned rendering. TransPhy first predicts the demonstrated rule and an explicit query-specific target-state description, and then synthesizes the target image through token-wise mixture-of-experts adaptation, with expert routing guided by localized transition cues. Experiments show that TransPhy improves physical-rule adherence, query consistency, and unseen-rule generalization over existing visual in-context editing methods.

articles.title: ExMesh++: From Multi-View Images to Relightable UV-PBR Mesh Assets via Topology-Adaptive Reconstruction and Decomposition
articles.content: Multi-view reconstruction extends beyond surface recovery to editable and relightable mesh assets. Such assets require well-formed topology, valid UV parameterization, and explicit PBR material maps. Existing surface reconstruction approaches optimize implicit fields, Gaussian primitives, or other intermediate representations. Converting them into such assets often requires surface extraction and texture baking. Inverse-rendering methods estimate materials and illumination, yet these components often remain tied to neural fields or point-based primitives rather than the final mesh. Joint optimization of geometry, materials, and lighting may also allow these variables to compensate for one another, leading to ambiguous decomposition. To address these limitations, we present ExMesh++, a staged framework for reconstructing relightable UV-PBR mesh assets from multi-view images. The first stage refines explicit mesh geometry and topology through adaptive vertex splitting and merging, while maintaining UV consistency as the topology changes. The second stage fixes the resulting mesh-UV carrier and optimizes UV-space PBR maps together with environment lighting. Building on this stable carrier, ExMesh++ models one-bounce diffuse indirect illumination through secondary-ray tracing with shared UV-PBR materials. Experiments demonstrate competitive geometry accuracy, strong relighting performance, and direct usability of the exported assets in standard DCC workflows.

articles.title_zh: ExMesh++:从多维图像到可发光的紫外-PBR 通过地形学 -- -- 动态重建和分解的网格资产

ExMesh++在这种稳定的载体的基础上,通过利用共享的紫外-PBR材料进行二次射线跟踪,采用一气相通的分散间接照明模式。 实验显示竞争的几何精度,强烈的再光性能,以及标准DCC工作流程中出口资产的可直接使用性.

articles.title: MatReplace: A Reference-Free, Conditioning-Aligned Benchmark for Material Replacement in Interior Scenes
articles.content: Material replacement is a common interior-design operation: changing the material of a selected surface while preserving its geometry, surroundings, and illumination. Despite its commercial relevance, no public benchmark isolates this task, and evaluating it is challenging. Reference-based metrics penalize valid outputs in this inherently one-to-many setting, favor the style of the reference generator, and cannot fairly compare editors that receive different forms of guidance. We introduce MatReplace, a reference-free benchmark that evaluates edits along four verifiable dimensions: local material correctness, global lighting harmony, outside preservation, and inside structure. It defines three tracks that vary one conditioning signal at a time: (A) instruction only, (B) instruction plus region mask, and (C) material reference image instead of instruction. Our results reveal a clear divide between naming and visually grounding materials. In Track A, leading closed-source editors achieve exemplar-level material rendering and surpass the exemplar anchor under our primary aggregate. In Track B, masks help only mask-compatible models with weak scene preservation, with task-paired, single-seed effects ranging from +0.137 to -0.090 across aligned model families. In Track C, reference-image conditioning degrades every family under both aggregates, by -0.031 to -0.508; in the worst cases, models repaint the reference image itself and perform worse than returning the input unchanged. Thus, named-material rendering is largely solved by the strongest closed editors on this distribution, but grounding materials from pixels remains an open challenge. Expert ratings validate our ranking (Kendall's tau = 0.68) and align with our aggregates more closely than GT-referenced or CLIP-based baselines.

articles.title_zh: MatReplace:一个无参考、条件一致的内部场景材料替换基准
articles.content_zh: 材料置换是一种常见的内置-设计操作:在保留其几何,周边和发光的同时改变所选地表的材料. 尽管它具有商业上的相关性,但没有任何公共基准将这项任务孤立开来,因此评估工作具有挑战性。 基于参考的衡量标准会惩罚这种内在的一对多设置中的有效产出,有利于参考生成器的风格,不能公平地比较接受不同形式的指导的编辑. 我们引入了MatReplace,这是一个无参考基准,它按照四个可核查的维度来评价编辑:局部物质正确性,全球照明和谐性,外部保存,以及内部结构. 它定义了三个每次改变一个调制信号的轨道:(A) 仅指示,(B) 指示外加区域口罩,(C) 材料参考图像而不是指示. 我们的结果显示,命名材料和视基材料之间有明显的区别。 在"轨迹A"中,主要的闭源编辑器实现实例级的材料渲染,并超越了我们主集合下的实例级锚. 在"B轨"中,口罩只帮助与场景保护薄弱相容的口罩相容模型,任务活化后,单种子效应从+0.137到-0.090不等于对齐的模组家族. 在Track C中,参考图像调制将两个集合下的每个家族降解为-0.031到-0.508;在最糟糕的情况下,模型重新油漆参考图像本身,其性能比返回输入时不变更差. 因此,命名-材料渲染主要是由这个发行版上最强的闭合编辑器解决的,但是从像素上打地基的材料仍然是一个公开的挑战. 专家评分验证我们的排名(Kendall's tau = 0.68),并与我们的汇总比GT参考或基于CLIP的基线更接近.

articles.title: DRRG: A Discrete Diffusion Framework for Radiology Report Generation
articles.content:
Purpose: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) has been widely explored to improve reporting accuracy and reduce radiologists' workload. Most existing methods rely on autoregressive (AR) frameworks that generate reports token by token and cannot revise earlier content, making them prone to error propagation and inconsistent with the iterative refinement process of radiological reporting. In contrast, discrete diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, naturally enabling report refinement. However, DLLMs have not been extensively investigated for RRG. In this study, we developed and evaluated a discrete diffusion framework for RRG that enables iterative refinement rather than conventional left-to-right autoregressive decoding.
  Materials and methods: We developed DRRG, a DLLM-based framework that formulates RRG as iterative masked-token denoising. DRRG incorporates a clinical-entities-aware complementary mask to improve token supervision coverage and emphasize clinically important entities, together with a concept-conditioning module that injects image-derived clinical concepts into visual representations. DRRG was trained and evaluated on MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert Plus.
  Results: On MIMIC-CXR, DRRG achieved BLEU-4 of 0.210, CheXpert-F1 of 0.549, RadGraph-F1 of 0.281, GREEN of 0.360, and RaTEScore of 0.604, outperforming the compared methods on most reported metrics, despite employing a substantially smaller LLM decoder. On CheXpert Plus, DRRG achieved the highest BLEU-4 (0.119) and CheXpert-F1 (0.347) among the compared methods.
  Conclusion: Discrete diffusion provides an effective alternative to autoregressive radiology report generation by enabling iterative, bidirectional report refinement. Incorporating clinically focused masking and image-derived concept conditioning improves report quality and clinical consistency.

articles.title_zh: DRRG:辐射学报告生成的分散传播框架
articles.content_zh:
目的:已广泛探索自动放射学报告生成(RRG),以提高报告准确性并减少放射学家的工作量. 多数现有方法都依靠自动递减框架,这种框架产生象征性的报告,不能修改以前的内容,使它们容易出现错误并不符合辐射报告迭代完善过程。 相形之下,离散扩散的大型语言模型(DLLMs)通过迭代去诺化生成文本,自然使报告得以完善. 然而,DLLMs并没有因为RRG而被广泛调查. 在这项研究中,我们制定并评价了RRG的离散扩散框架,该框架能够进行迭代完善,而不是常规的左向右自旋分解.
材料和方法: 我们开发了DRRG,这是一个基于DLLM的框架,它将RRG作为迭代口罩去音. DRRG包含一个临床-实体-认知辅助口罩来提高象征性的监管覆盖面,并强调临床上重要的实体,同时包含一个概念调节模块,将图像衍生的临床概念注入视觉表现. DRRG接受了MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus的培训和评价.
结果:关于MIMIC-CXR,DRRG取得了0.210的BLEU-4、0.549的CheXpert-F1、0.281的RadGraph-F1、0.360的GREEN和0.604的RETEScore,尽管采用了大大小得多的LLM解码器,但比大多数报告指标的比较方法要好。 在CheXpert Plus上,DRRG在比较方法中实现了最高的BLEU-4(0.119)和CheXpert-F1(0.347).
结论:分散传播通过促进迭接,双向报告完善,为自旋式放射学报告生成提供了有效的替代. 纳入以临床为重点的蒙面和图像衍生概念条件可提高报告质量和临床一致性。

articles.title: Joint-Embedding Prediction of Masked Point Tubes for Self-Supervised Learning on 4D Point Cloud Videos
articles.content: Self-supervised representation learning for 4D point cloud videos is challenging because annotations are costly and reconstruction-based pretraining can overemphasize low-level geometric details. We propose a JEPA-style framework that learns from unlabeled spatiotemporal point clouds through latent point-tube prediction. Instead of reconstructing raw coordinates, the model masks spatiotemporal regions and predicts their target representations from visible context representations in feature space. To stabilize latent prediction, we incorporate Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization, which encourages non-collapsed embeddings without relying on explicit reconstruction targets. This formulation aims to capture both spatial structure and temporal dynamics while keeping the pretraining objective aligned with downstream semantic recognition. Experiments on action and gesture recognition benchmarks show that the learned representations improve downstream fine-tuning, limited-label learning, and cross-dataset transfer. These results suggest that JEPA-style latent prediction is a promising alternative to reconstruction-centered pretraining for 4D point cloud videos.

articles.title_zh: 4D 点云视频自导自演的蒙面点管的联合预告
articles.content_zh: 4D点云视频的自我监督表现学习具有挑战性,因为说明成本高昂,基于重建的预训可以过分强调低等几何细节. 我们提出了一个JEPA式的框架,通过潜在点-立方体的预测,从无标签的点云中吸取教训。 模型没有重建原始坐标,而是从特征空间的可见上下文表示来遮盖空间并预测其目标表示. 为了稳定潜在预测,我们加入了Sketched Isotropic Gaussian 正规化,它鼓励不依赖明确重建目标而嵌入。 这种提法旨在同时掌握空间结构和时间动态,同时保持培训前目标与下游语义识别相一致. 关于行动和手势识别基准的实验表明,学到的表述改进了下游的微调、有限标签的学习和跨数据集的传输。 这些结果表明,JEPA式的潜在预测是4D点云视频以重建为中心的预训的一种有希望的替代办法。

articles.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
articles.content: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) remains hard in long-horizon tasks, where growing histories obscure the task state and misalign skill invocation. We introduce Recuris, a recursive Experiential-Working Memory architecture for long-horizon agent harnesses, in which Working Memory tracks task progress and guides skill selection from Experiential Memory, grounding skill use in current needs rather than the full history. This coupling also turns execution into structured evidence that localizes failures to specific memory components. Across tasks, a fixed Meta-Agent turns that evidence into localized, validation-gated updates to Skill Memory that reshape execution and yield new evidence, forming a bounded recursive memory-evolution loop. Across four long-horizon benchmarks and ten models, Recuris improves task success in 35 of the 37 completed model-benchmark pairs, carrying frontier models to SOTA-level task success: on tau-bench it adds +17.8 points to GPT-5.6 Sol and +15.6 to Claude Opus 5, taking Opus 5 to 87.9%, and +16.6/+13.5 points on Qwen3.6-27B/35B on SkillFlow. The advantage widens as the interaction horizon grows, to +32.2 points on the longest tasks, and common long-horizon failures fall by up to 80%. These results position recursively evolving memory as a scalable foundation for RSI, enabling agents to continuously transform accumulated experience into increasingly effective long-horizon behavior. articles.title_zh: 长视代理的递归性旅行-工作记忆进化
articles.content_zh: 在长期任务中,不断增长的历史模糊了任务状态并错误地引用了技能。 我们引入了Recuris,一种用于长视距代理机的递归性体验-工作记忆架构,其中Work Memory跟踪任务进度并指导从Excurrious Memory中选择技能,将技能的使用定位于当前需求而非全史. 这种耦合也使执行变成结构化的证据,将故障本地化到特定的内存组件. 在整个任务中,一个固定的Meta-Agent将证据转化为本地化的,验证的更新到Skill Memory,它重塑了执行和产生出新的证据,形成了一个有限度的递归内存-进取循环. 跨出4个长视距基准和10个模型,Recuris改进了37个已完工的模型-基准对中35个的任务成功率,将前沿模型带到了SOTA一级的任务成功率:在tau-beng上,它增加了+17.8分为GPT-5.6 Sol和+15.6分为克洛德·奥普斯5分,取取了Opus5到87.9%,在SkillFlow上为Qwen3.6-27B/35B分. 优势随着互动视野的扩大而扩大,在最长的任务上达到+32.2分,而常见的长视差故障会下降高达80%. 这些成果将递相演化的记忆定位为RSI可扩展的基础,使物剂能将所积累的经验不断转化为越来越有效的长视距行为. 代码:https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Recuris (中文(简体) ).

articles.title: BrowserForge: Scaling Web Episode via Parallel Browser Sandboxes
articles.content: Web agents that act from rendered pixels avoid the fragility and heavy token cost of reading a page's HTML or accessibility tree, but training them depends on large amounts of high-quality interaction trajectories, and how to produce such data at scale remains an open problem. Public datasets typically contain only a few thousand trajectories drawn from a fixed and narrow set of websites, and even recent automated synthesis pipelines stay bound to predefined site lists or tutorial sources, so the number of distinct websites the agent ever sees barely grows. We present BrowserForge, a framework that generates web interaction data at scale by driving many browser sandboxes in parallel over the open web. BrowserForge couples three components: an open-web sourcing stage that exposes the agent to hundreds of thousands of real, openly reachable websites; a sandbox cluster manager that schedules hundreds of concurrent browsers with high utilization; and a Proposer-Solver dual-agent loop that turns a raw page into an executable task and then collects a verified trajectory for it. A rule-plus-model cleaning pipeline removes failed runs and rewrites the surviving reasoning into a single unified chain-of-thought style. Page structure such as the accessibility tree is used only as a synthesis-time signal; the agent we train and release acts purely from the screenshot. The resulting corpus contains 203,238 trajectories, each collected from a distinct website, larger and more diverse than prior trajectory datasets. Fine-tuning a compact multimodal model on this corpus raises its success rate on the live Online-Mind2Web from 25.66% to 33.33% and consistently improves step accuracy on the static Multimodal-Mind2Web, with the gain growing as the corpus scales. Controlled analyses further confirm that open-web sourcing and broad website coverage are key contributors to the observed improvement.

articles.title_zh: 浏览器Forge:通过并行浏览器 Sandboxs 放大网页集
articles.content_zh: 使用所制成的像素行事的Web代理避免了读取一页的HTML或可访问树的脆弱和沉重的象征性成本,但培训它们依赖于大量高质量的交互轨迹,如何在规模上生成此类数据仍然是一个尚未解决的问题. 公共数据集一般只包含从固定而狭义的一组网站中抽取出几千个轨迹,而即使是最近的自动合成管道也仍然被捆绑在预定义的网站列表或教程源上,因此代理商从未见过的不同网站数量几乎没有增长. 我们呈现浏览器Forge,这个框架通过在开放的网络上平行地驱动许多浏览器沙盒,以规模生成网络交互数据. 浏览器Forge夫妇三部分:一个开放的网络来源阶段,使代理商接触到数十万个真实的,可公开访问的网站;一个沙盒集群管理器,以高利用率安排数百个并行浏览器;以及一个Proposer-Solver双代理环路,将一个原始页面变成可执行的任务,然后收集一个经过核实的路径. 一个规则+型式的清洁管去掉了失败的跑道,将幸存的推理改写为单一的统一的思想链式. 无障碍树等页面结构只用作合成-时间信号;我们训练和释放的剂纯粹是从截图中放出的行为. 由此得出的数据包含203,238个轨迹,每个轨迹都取自一个不同的网站,比以往的轨迹数据集更大,更多样化. 精细地调整了有关这项文书的紧凑的多模式模式,将在线-Mind2Web网上直播的成功率从25.66%提高到33.33%,并不断提高静态多模式-Mind2Web的步入精度,收益随着文书规模的增长而增加。 受控制的分析进一步证实,开放的网络来源和广泛的网站覆盖面是所观察到的改进的关键。

articles.title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on investment judgments falls to the experimental noise floor even as direct retrieval remains accurate. The pattern replicates across model families and judgment tasks and in experiments removing real disclosures from actual 10-K filings. More capable models postpone but do not eliminate the gap. Causal memory interventions show that compressed summaries and source-text lookup jointly transmit disclosures into judgments. Workflow architecture determines whether this transmission succeeds: chunk-and-summarize pipelines evict relevant information, whereas a targeted, structured restatement adjacent to the decision restores its influence. AI analyst performance is therefore jointly determined by model capability and workflow architecture. Retrieval-based evaluations can certify systems whose investment judgments ignore information they demonstrably retrieved.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 阅读不是使用:检索、判决和AI财务研究工作流程的设计
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地被部署为AI分析员,处理财务披露并支持AI协助的投资决定. 然而,这类系统通常通过它们能够检索到什么来评估,而不是通过检索到的信息是否影响其判断。 我们发现在长文财务分析中存在检索-整合差距。 我们发现,即使直接检索仍然准确,但风险披露对投资判决的影响仍属于实验噪音层。 这种模式在模型家庭和判决任务以及从实际的10K档案中去除真实披露的实验中相复制. 更有能力的模型推迟了,但并不能消除差距。 原因记忆干预表明,压缩摘要和源文本检索共同将披露内容传送到判决中。 工作流结构决定了这种传输是否成功:块式和总结式的管道驱逐了相关信息,而与决定相邻的有针对性,有条理的重述则恢复了它的影响力. 因此,AI分析师的性能由模型能力和工作流程架构共同决定. 基于检索的评价可以验证其投资判断忽视其明显检索到的信息的系统。

articles.title: Structurally-bounded Agentic Graph Exploration for Evidence-Grounded Scholarly DeepSearch
articles.content: We present Crase, a bounded and inspectable alternative to deep research agents for scholarly search. Instead of an open-ended search loop, Crase queries a search engine once for seed papers, expands them along their 1.5-hop citation neighborhood, prunes citation edges whose claims lack entailment support, and ranks the remaining papers with a recency-aware random walk. This makes the candidate set, the reason each paper is kept, and the stopping condition explicit and fixed before inference. On LitSearch and one further benchmarks over a 500K-paper arXiv corpus, Crase outperforms deep research agents built on proprietary models by up to 3$\times$ recall@50 at roughly a third of the cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以结构为界的取证代理图勘探
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍克拉斯,一个有限度和可检查的替代 深层研究人员进行学术搜索。 Crase不使用无限制的搜索回路,而是为种子论文查询过一次搜索引擎,沿着他们1.5跳的引用相邻区域扩展,prunes引用相接的边缘,其主张缺乏需要支持,并将所剩的论文排列在重新意识到的随机行走中. 这使得候选人设定,每张纸被保留的原因,停止状态在推论前明确和固定. 在LitSearch和一份500K纸币的再基准上,Crase比建立在专利模型之上的深层研究代理商要多出3美元,大约占成本的三分之一。

articles.title: Linear Probing Provides Robust and Efficient Detection of Machine-Generated Text
articles.content: Distinguishing machine-generated text (MGT) from human-written text (HWT) becomes increasingly important due to potential misuse. However, most supervised detectors often degrade out-of-domain (OOD) and require large, diverse training sets. In this work, we analyze the linearity and quality of MGT representations and show that simple linear probes outperform a wide range of detectors while being substantially more sample-efficient. We first show that MGT and HWT latent representations are linearly separable in low-dimensional space, and provide a plausible explanation for this separability through systematic differences in their representation quality. Motivated by these insights, we train two variants of simple linear probes and evaluate them across 4 benchmarks against 16 baselines. Probes consistently improve OOD detection (+11 AUC), requiring solely ${<}100$ samples to reach near-peak performance. We show that this transferability arises because probes recover a shared latent MGT direction that generalizes across diverse settings. Finally, we demonstrate that probing vectors capture a continuous spectrum of ``machineness'', highlighting their potential for fine-grained estimation of AI-edited text. Overall, our work provides insights into latent-space differences between MGT and HWT and demonstrates the potential of linear probes as as robust and sample-efficient MGT detectors. We release our code on~\href{https://github.com/gerritq/mgt_probes}{github}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 线性测试为机器生成的文本提供强大而有效的检测
articles.content_zh: 由于可能的滥用,将机器生成的文本与人文文本区分开来变得越来越重要。 然而,大多数受监督的探测器往往降解出域外(OOD),需要大量多样的培训。 在这项工作中,我们分析MGT表达的线性和质量,并表明简单的线性探测器在大幅提高样本效率的同时,能超过广泛的探测器。 我们首先表明,MGT和HWT潜在代表物在低维空间中线性分离,并通过其代表物质量的系统性差异,为这种分离性提供了合理解释。 受这些洞察力的驱使,我们培养出两个简单的线性探测器的变体,并对照16个基线,在4个基准上加以评价。 被探测者不断改进了OD检测(+11 AUC),只需要100美元的样本就可以达到近峰性能. 我们表明,这种可转移性之所以产生,是因为探测器恢复了一种共同的MGT潜入方向,该方向将不同环境普遍化。 最后,我们表明,探测向量能够捕捉“机器”的连续频谱,突出了其对AI编辑文本进行精细估计的潜力。 总体而言,我们的工作使人们深入了解MGT和HWT之间的潜在空间差异,并表明线性探测器作为强力和样品效率高的MGT探测器的潜力。 我们公布我们的代码在 ~\href{https://github.com/gerritq/mgt_probes}{github}上。

articles.title: ExpConCAD: Experience-Guided Text-to-CAD Generation from Shape Descriptions with Implicit Spatial Constraints
articles.content: Text-to-CAD aims to generate executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, real-world descriptions are often underspecified and omit critical spatial constraints required for valid CAD construction, a challenge that has been largely overlooked by existing methods. In this paper, we argue that missing spatial constraints should be inferred with respect to the underlying construction structure and informed by reusable design experience. Based on this insight, we propose ExpConCAD, an experience-enhanced framework for implicit spatial constraint completion. ExpConCAD first recovers the intended construction structure and constraint scopes, then retrieves relevant constraint-completion experience for similar scopes to complete the missing spatial constraints, and finally generates executable CadQuery programs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpConCAD and provide insights into the role of construction structure understanding and experience memory in spatial constraint completion. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Hotjiashell/ExpConCAD.

articles.title_zh: ExpectCAD:经验引导文本到CAD 带有内在空间限制的形状描述生成
articles.content_zh: 文本到CAD旨在从自然语言描述生成可执行的CAD程序. 然而,现实世界的描述往往不够具体,省略了有效的CAD构建所需的关键空间限制,而现有的方法在很大程度上忽视了这一挑战. 在本文中,我们主张,应当根据可重复使用的设计经验,对基本建筑结构推断出缺失的空间限制。 基于这一见解,我们提议采用ExconCAD这一经验增强的框架,以完成暗含的空间限制。 ExponCAD首先回收预定的建筑结构和制约范围,再为相似范围检索相关的制约-完成经验来完成缺失的空间限制,并最后生成可执行的CadQuery程序. 广泛的实验证明了ExconCAD的有效性,并提供了对建筑结构理解的作用的洞察力并体验了空间约束完成中的记忆. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/Hotjiashell/ExpConCAD上查阅。

articles.title: The RAT: A Unified Bayesian Model for RAG Evaluation
articles.content: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems requires assessing not only end-to-end correctness but also how individual components interact and how errors propagate through the pipeline. We introduce a Bayesian evaluation framework that jointly models retrieval success, abstention behavior, and answer correctness, factorized according to the pipeline's information flow. The model distinguishes task success. Whether the user received a correct answer (from generator success) and whether the generator behaved appropriately given the retrieval outcome. We apply the framework to 27 RAG configurations across three datasets, three retrievers, and three generators, and show that the conditional decomposition reveals substantial behavioral differences between systems that appear equivalent under marginal metrics. We further analyze the annotation allocation problem, demonstrating that retrieval-success annotations are more informative than task-success annotations for estimating policy adherence, and provide an information-theoretic explanation for this asymmetry. Finally, we extend the model to incorporate LLM-as-a-judge annotations as calibrated noisy observations, enabling practitioners to combine limited human judgments with cheaper automated assessments within a unified probabilistic model.

articles.title_zh: RAT:一个统一的巴伊西亚区域评估组评价模式
articles.content_zh: 评估检索强化生成系统不仅需要评估端到端的正确性,还需要评估单个组件如何相互作用,以及错误如何通过管道传播。 我们引入了一个贝叶斯式的评价框架, 共同模拟检索成功率,弃权行为, 并回答正确性, 根据管道信息流的因素化。 该模型区分任务成功. 用户是否收到正确的答案(来自生成器成功),以及生成器在检索结果下是否行为适当. 我们把框架应用于横跨三个数据集的27个RAG配置,3个检索器和3个发电机,并显示有条件的分解揭示了边缘度量下看起来等同的系统之间的实质性行为差异. 我们进一步分析了注释分配问题,表明检索-成功说明比任务-成功说明更有助于估计政策遵守情况,并为这种不对称提供了信息理论解释。 最后,我们扩大模型,将LLM-as-a-judge的说明作为校准的噪音观测,使从业人员能够在统一概率模型内将有限的人文判断与更便宜的自动评估结合起来。

articles.title: Method, Mind, and Morality: How People Make Sense of Artificial Intelligence
articles.content: How can humans make sense of the rapid takeoff of artificial intelligence (AI)? We studied the sensemaking dynamics of AI through an open-ended, mixed-methods study with computational text analysis of millions of AI-related newspaper articles and social media posts grounded in 57 semi-structured interviews with AI professionals in 2021 and 2023--before and after the recent surge of public interest. We identify a range of sociological frames (interpretive schemas that structure collective cognition) and show how AI professionals use frames to address significant cognitive challenges, such as assigning responsibility for societal impacts. We develop a framework of three primary debates across which frames are adopted and contested: (i) the $\textit{method}$ of AI development, between frames of top-down expert systems and bottom-up emergent capabilities, (ii) the $\textit{mind}$ of an AI system, ranging from a passive tool to a humanlike "digital mind," and (iii) the $\textit{morality}$ of how AI is used, particularly the decision of whether to slow down or speed up AI development. As humanity enters the era of transformative AI, technologists and policymakers must account for the framing dynamics that will circumscribe our beliefs, values, and actions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 方法、思想和道德:人们如何创造人工智能
articles.content_zh: 人工智能的快速起飞(AI) 人类如何解释?. 我们研究了AI的感知动力,通过一项开放式的混合方法研究,对与AI有关的上百万篇报纸文章和社交媒体文章进行了计算文本分析,这些文章基于2021年和2023年----最近公众兴趣激增之前和之后与AI专业人员的57个半结构化访谈。 我们确定了一系列社会学框架(解释组织集体认知的方法),并显示AI专业人士如何使用框架来应对重大的认知挑战,例如分配社会影响的责任. 我们建立了一个由三个主要辩论组成的框架,通过和辩论的框架:(一) AI开发的$\textit{方法}美元,介于自上而下的专家系统框架和自下而上的新能力之间;(二) AI体系的$\textit{mind}美元,从被动工具到人性的"数字思维",以及(三) AI如何使用的$\textit{道德}美元,特别是是减缓还是加快AI开发的决定. 在人类进入变革性AI时代之际,科技工作者和决策者必须说明将限制我们信仰、价值观和行动的框架动态。

articles.title: SkillForge: Evolving Verifiable Skills for Reinforcement Learning Agents
articles.content: Large language model (LLM) agents are trained with reinforcement learning (RL) for complex decision-making tasks. However, most RL-trained agents remain episodic and cannot accumulate reusable knowledge across episodes. Recent skill-based approaches, such as SkillRL, attempt to address this issue by extracting skills from raw trajectories, but treat the skill bank as an append-only repository without verifying whether stored skills remain effective. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a framework for continuous skill evolution that enables skills to be verified and refined through environment interaction. By making skill usage explicit during agent interaction, RL can directly optimize both environment actions and skill invocation decisions. SkillForge further introduces evidence-based skill verification and multi-pathway skill induction, allowing the skill bank to continuously grow while maintaining its quality. Extensive experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld show that SkillForge consistently outperforms SkillRL, demonstrating the effectiveness of continuously verified skills in training stronger LLM agents.

articles.title_zh: SkillForge:强化学习代理者可验证技能的发展
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)代理员接受强化学习(RL)培训,以完成复杂的决策任务. 然而,大多数经过RL培训的特工人员仍然是零星的,无法在各种情况下积累可重复使用的知识。 最近的以技能为基础的方法,如SkillRL,试图通过从原始轨迹中取出技能来解决这个问题,但将技能库作为仅存附件的存储库,而不核实所储存的技能是否依然有效. 在本文中,我们提出SkillForge,这是持续技能演变的框架,通过环境互动,能够验证和完善技能. 通过在代理互动中明确技能使用,RL可以直接优化环境行动和技能引用决定. SkillForge进一步引入了基于证据的技能验证和多路径技能入门,使技能库在保持质量的同时能持续增长. 在ALFWorld,WebShop,和AppWorld上的广泛实验显示,SkillForge的性能始终高于SkillRL,证明了不断被验证的技能在训练更强大的LLM代理方面的有效性.

articles.title: Design and Empirical Characterization of a Hardware-Realized Turing Machine with Automated Card-Based Programming
articles.content: Physical implementations of Turing Machines remain rare, and existing electromechanical demonstrators and mechanical logic games typically require manual operator intervention, either to trigger each computational step or to reconfigure the state table, or both. This restricts prior physical models to short, operator-paced demonstrations and prevents autonomous execution of extended computations. This paper addresses that gap with a hardware Turing Machine that enables autonomous multi-step execution and reprogrammable optical input without manual intervention between programs. The system integrates an Arduino Mega for state-transition logic, dual NEMA 17 stepper motors for bidirectional tape actuation, infrared reflectance sensors for symbol detection, and an ESP32-CAM-based optical punched-card reader for automated state-table loading. Hole detection under non-uniform illumination used a Breadth-First Search flood-fill algorithm with local adaptive thresholding rather than fixed global thresholding, driven by the memory and library constraints of the ESP32-CAM's microcontroller environment; this improved card-decoding accuracy from 75% to 90% (100% with mechanical card flattening) on a 20-card test set. Mechanical evaluation showed fabrication accuracy of +/-0.15 mm, rack-and-pinion positional error below 0.3 mm across 50 trials, and voltage supply stability within +/-0.2 V under full system load. End-to-end computation was validated against a parallel software simulator (tlang), with all hardware outputs matching the simulated reference exactly across multiple test programs. The system advances prior physical Turing Machine demonstrations through autonomous execution, reprogrammable optical input, and quantitative evaluation of its mechanical, optical, and computational performance.

articles.title_zh: 采用自动卡制编程的硬件再现图灵机的设计和经验特性
articles.content_zh: Turing Machines的物理实施仍然罕见,现有的机电示威者和机械逻辑游戏通常需要人工操作者干预,要么触发每个计算步骤,要么重新配置状态表,要么两者兼而有之. 这就将先前的物理模型限制在短的,运算符节奏的演示,并阻止了扩展计算工作的自主执行. 本文用硬件图灵机解决了这一缺口,该机能实现自主多步执行和可再编程的光学输入,而不在程序之间进行人工干预. 该系统集成了一个用于状态-过渡逻辑的Arduino Mega,双向NEMA 17步马达用于双向磁带活化,红外反射传感器用于符号检测,以及一个基于ESP32-CAM的光学出击卡读取器用于自动状态表装入. 非统一照明下的洞道探测采用了有局部适应性阈值而不是固定全球阈值的Breadth-First搜索洪填算法,由ESP32-CAM的微控制器环境的内存和图书限制所驱动;这一改进的卡解码精度由75%到90%(用机械卡平整)在一个20卡测试集上. 机械评价显示,在50次试验中,制造精度为+/-0.15毫米,机架和螺旋位置误差低于0.3毫米,电压供应稳定性为+/-0.2。 V在全系统负载。 端到端的计算是通过一个平行的软件模拟器(tlanng)进行验证的,所有硬件输出都完全通过多个测试程序匹配模拟参考. 系统通过自主执行,可再编程光学输入,以及对其机械,光学,和计算性能进行定量评价,推进了之前的物理图灵机演示.

articles.title: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
articles.content: Self-improving LLM agents refine answers, not the process that produces those answers. Systems that add a meta-level hold that level fixed, and those that edit themselves must leave part of their own editing machinery untouched to stay stable, capping the meta-depth they realize at roughly two. We present Meta$^n$, which keeps the meta-operation fixed and recurses on its input instead. That operation, $Ω$, is applied repeatedly to its own products, reading the traces of the solver stack below together with the code that produced them, then writing the next layer as a strategic pre-process and a library of callable helpers. Because $Ω$ never changes, it cannot destabilize the system, and because its input strictly grows, each layer reasons from a higher vantage than the last. Depth is set by convergence rather than fixed in advance, and an evolutionary archive searches over layer chains. Across two backbones, Meta$^n$ outperforms prior self-improving agents on all eight benchmark families. The sharpest case is ARC-AGI-2, built to resist skill memorization, where it alone scores above zero. Ablations indicate that most of the gain from recursion comes from the conditioning each layer passes to the next, and distinct layer roles emerge with depth although no prompt prescribes them. Code available at https://github.com/minnesotanlp/meta-n
